name: project-git
description: How git works in an Archon Horizon workspace — one out-of-tree workspace ledger (no per-project repos); read a project's history by pathspec or by a session's commit trailers.
---

Read this before running `git diff`/`git log` on a project.

## The model

- **One out-of-tree workspace ledger.** Archon commits to a single repo whose git
  dir is `.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git` with the workspace **root** as its
  work tree (driven via `--git-dir`/`--work-tree`). `<root>/.git` is deliberately
  untouched — it is reserved for a user repo. The ledger records one commit per
  completed session: `config.yaml`, the session's scoped project files, and
  `.archon-horizon/` shared state; never the binary git dirs under
  `.archon-horizon/vcs/`, locks, or other volatile internals.
- **There are no per-project repositories.** A project directory has no nested
  `.git/`, and there is no `.archon-horizon/vcs/<project>.git`. A project's
  "history" is simply the workspace ledger filtered to that project's path.
- **You record your own work by committing to the ledger** with plain `git` (see
  below). Commit after each independently useful, verified proof/file/tooling
  change, before a long build or delegated review, and before expanding scope.
  A multi-hour implementation session should normally have several commits; one
  commit is appropriate only when the work is genuinely atomic. The message +
  diff is how progress is read, so use a semantic, math-first subject. Provenance
  trailers are added automatically; do not write them.

So a plain `git diff` at the root sees only a user repo (if any), never Archon's.
Drive the out-of-tree workspace ledger explicitly (or use `hgit`).

## Recording your work (committing)

Commits go to the ledger, **not** to `<root>/.git` and **not** via any project
`.git` (there is none). Do **not** `export GIT_DIR` / `GIT_WORK_TREE` yourself — that
would redirect `lake` and other tooling. Two equivalent ways to commit:

```bash
# 1) The `hgit` wrapper (on the session env as $HORIZON_GIT) — plain git, ledger-scoped:
"$HORIZON_GIT" add path/to/File.lean
"$HORIZON_GIT" commit -m "feat(chapter): prove foo_lemma" \
  --trailer 'Summary=**Proof.** Closed the compactness step using $K \subseteq X$.'

# 2) The explicit form (identical effect):
git --git-dir="$HORIZON_LEDGER_GIT_DIR" --work-tree="$HORIZON_LEDGER_WORK_TREE" \
    add path/to/File.lean
git --git-dir="$HORIZON_LEDGER_GIT_DIR" --work-tree="$HORIZON_LEDGER_WORK_TREE" \
    commit -m "feat(chapter): prove foo_lemma" \
    --trailer 'Summary=**Proof.** Closed the compactness step using $K \subseteq X$.'
```

Ordinary git: the ledger's index tracks HEAD, so `add` then `commit` records your
files on top of it. Horizon's own commits stage in a private index and never leave
anything staged in your way.

- **Prefer the pathspec commit** — name the paths on the commit itself:
  `"$HORIZON_GIT" commit -m "…" --trailer 'Summary=…' -- path/to/File.lean`
  It records exactly those files, ignores whatever else may be staged, and git
  builds its tree from the **current** HEAD — so it cannot silently revert a
  concurrent session's files the way a commit built on a stale index can.
- Add at least one **`Summary` trailer** explaining the important change, not
  merely repeating the subject. Use one trailer per distinct explanation when
  useful. Its value supports Markdown and LaTeX, so concise mathematical context
  such as `--trailer 'Summary=**Invariant.** Preserves $f(x)=x$ on $A$.'` renders
  directly in the dashboard commit item. Keep each trailer on one line; repeat
  `--trailer 'Summary=…'` for a few separate points.
- Do not wait for the whole task to be complete. A checkpoint commit must build
  or otherwise be internally coherent, but it may explicitly leave the next
  named obligation open.
- Stage **explicit paths** you changed rather than `add -A` — the work tree is the
  whole workspace, so `-A` can sweep in unrelated files.
- `Archon-Run`/`Session`/`Role`/`Task`/`Projects` trailers are stamped for you by a
  hook from the session env; your message stays clean.
- Build artifacts (`.lake`, `*.olean`, …) are excluded automatically, and any
  high-confidence credential is **redacted to `XXXX`** in the staged content (not
  blocked), so a broad add still won't leak a secret into the ledger.
- If the guard reports *"redacted possible secret(s) to XXXX"*, it scrubbed a
  matched credential and let the commit through — **rotate the real credential**,
  and check you didn't stage more than you meant to (`ARCHON_HORIZON_ALLOW_SECRETS=1`
  skips the scan entirely). A *separate* guard still **blocks** a commit that would
  silently delete tracked files you didn't change (a stale-index clobber); re-seed
  the index (`git read-tree HEAD && git add -- <your files>`) rather than forcing it.

Then verify **in the ledger**, and verify the **paths**, not just the SHA — a bare
`git cat-file` runs against `<root>/.git`, which has not seen your commit yet and will
make a perfectly real SHA look fabricated:

```bash
"$HORIZON_GIT" ls-tree --name-only HEAD -- path/to/File.lean   # empty ⇒ NOT in HEAD
```

## Concurrent sessions and the clobber guard

Several sessions may commit to the ledger at once. A commit whose index was
seeded from an older HEAD (e.g. `read-tree`, then a concurrent session commits,
then you commit) produces a tree that *lacks* the other session's new files —
plain git would commit it without any error and silently delete their work.
The ledger's `pre-commit` guard now rejects any commit that stages deletions
you did not ask for:

- *"this commit would DELETE N tracked file(s) you did not change"* — your
  index base is stale (or you are committing through a polluted shared index).
  **Do not override.** Re-seed and retry; your own edits are safe in the
  working tree, which concurrent commits never touch:

  ```bash
  "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree HEAD
  "$HORIZON_GIT" add -- <your files>
  "$HORIZON_GIT" commit -m "…"          # or just: commit -m "…" -- <your files>
  ```

- Deleting a file **on purpose** (moved/retired): set
  `ARCHON_HORIZON_ALLOW_DELETIONS=1` for that one commit.

At the **end of the session**, re-verify content — not just that HEAD moved —
since a stale-based commit elsewhere could have landed after yours (the guard
blocks new offenders, but belt-and-braces):

```bash
"$HORIZON_GIT" cat-file -e HEAD:path/to/File.lean && \
"$HORIZON_GIT" show HEAD:path/to/File.lean | diff -q - path/to/File.lean
```

If you were clobbered anyway: `read-tree HEAD`, re-add your files from the
working tree, commit once.

## Reading history / a project's diff

Run from the workspace root:

```bash
GD=.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git

git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. log  --oneline -n 20                       # whole ledger
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. log  --oneline -n 20 -- <project-path>     # one project
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. diff HEAD~1 -- <project-path>
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. diff HEAD~1 -- '<project-path>/*.lean'
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. show <sha>
```

Each commit carries provenance trailers — `Archon-Run`, `Archon-Session`,
`Archon-Role`, `Archon-Task`, `Archon-Projects` — so you can map a commit to the
run/session that made it and see what it touched without parsing prose:

```bash
git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. \
  log --format='%H %(trailers:key=Archon-Session,valueonly)' -- <project-path>
```

To see what the previous Horizon agent changed, find its session's commit(s) by
the `Archon-Session` trailer and diff each against **its own parent** (what that
commit changed).

## Caveats

- With parallel runs the ledger is one shared branch: commits from several runs
  interleave, and a commit's parent may belong to another run or a dashboard
  publish. Diff a commit against its own parent (what *that* commit changed), not
  across a span of sessions — that would fold in unrelated runs' changes.
- The bundled author identity is `Archon Horizon <archon-horizon@local>`.

     9	/-!
    10	# Projection coherence for the degree-zero Picard base-change comparison
    11	
    12	This file supplies the scheme-level equalities used to compare the affine transport
    13	families underlying `pic0Theta`. It proves that the inverse same-carrier comparison has
    14	the expected first projection over any field extension, and identifies the whole
    15	comparison at the identity extension with whiskering by `baseChange.idIso`.
    16	
    17	The proof keeps the proof-bearing `eqToIso` in `baseChange.idIso` opaque. Its component
    18	projection is obtained from adjunction conjugation and proof irrelevance, avoiding a
    19	large simplifier expansion of `Over.pullbackId`.
    20	-/

    22	set_option autoImplicit false

    24	universe u

    30	/-! ## Congruence of étale-plus transports (the reduction key)
    31	
    32	Both the base-field shuffle (`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle`, via `crossBaseTransportFamily`) and
    33	the curve transport (`PicEtAff.curveMap`, via `curveTransportFamily`) are
    34	`RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom`s, and `picEtAffHom_mk`/`descentHom_coe`/`relPicHom_mk`
    35	express the transport as `CechPic.map` of the family's `hom` scheme morphism. Hence two
    36	families with pointwise-equal `hom` fields induce equal transports — the lemma through which
    37	the two θ-cocycle atoms reduce to a scheme-morphism identity on the product carriers. -/
    38	theorem RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_congr {kD kE kT : Type u}
    39	    [Field kD] [Field kE] [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
    40	    {D : Over (Spec (.of kD))} {E : Over (Spec (.of kE))}
    41	    (S T : RelPicTransportFamily kT D E)
    42	    (h : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    43	      [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B], S.hom B = T.hom B)
    44	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]
    45	    [IsScalarTower kD kT A] [IsScalarTower kE kT A] (a : PicEtAff E A) :
    46	    S.picEtAffHom A a = T.picEtAffHom A a := by
    47	  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
    48	  | _ U x =>
    49	    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk]
    50	    refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk D U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
    51	    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe, RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe]
    52	    generalize (x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)) = y
    53	    induction y using relPic.ind with
    54	    | mk L =>
    55	      rw [RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, h]

    59	open Limits in
    60	/-- `Over.pullbackId`'s forward comparison has first projection the identity: the
    61	base-change-along-`𝟙` section reads off the original object on the first factor. -/
    62	theorem pullbackId_hom_app_left.{w} {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D] [HasPullbacks D]
    63	    {S : D} (X : Over S) :
    64	    (Over.pullbackId.hom.app X).left = pullback.fst X.hom (𝟙 S) := by
    65	  change ((conjugateEquiv (Over.mapPullbackAdj (𝟙 S))
    66	    (Adjunction.id (C := Over S)) (Over.mapId S).inv).app X).left = _
    67	  rw [conjugateEquiv_adjunction_id]
    68	  simp only [Over.comp_left, Over.mapId_inv_app_left,
    69	    Over.mapPullbackAdj_counit_app, Over.homMk_left]
    70	  simp
    71	
    72	open Limits in
    73	private theorem pullbackId_transport_hom_app_left.{w}
    74	    {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D] [HasPullbacks D] {S : D}
    75	    (f : S ⟶ S) (hf : f = 𝟙 S)
    76	    (h : Over.pullback f = Over.pullback (𝟙 S)) (X : Over S) :
    77	    ((eqToIso h ≪≫ Over.pullbackId).hom.app X).left = pullback.fst X.hom f := by
    78	  subst f
    79	  have hh : h = rfl := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    80	  cases hh
    81	  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_refl,
    82	    Over.comp_left, Category.id_comp] using pullbackId_hom_app_left X

    89	      = pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by

    94	/-- The inverse same-carrier comparison followed by the first projection is the first
    95	projection of the original curve, after composing with the base-change pullback map. -/
    96	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L]
    97	    [Algebra k L] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    98	    [Algebra k A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower k L A] :
    99	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv ≫

   101	          Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   102	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))) =
   103	      (fst C (overSpec k A)).left := by

   105	    Over.crossBaseIso_inv_fst]
   106	  change (C ◁ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).inv).left ≫
   107	    (fst C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj
   108	      (overSpec L A))).left = (fst C (overSpec k A)).left
   109	  exact Over.whiskerLeft_left_fst (mapOverSpecIso k L A).inv

   112	
   113	The K-1a Leg-4 atom is the scheme identity
   114	`((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv`,

   117	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
   118	/-- **The `snd` leg of the K-1a Leg-4 atom**: the whiskered identity base-change comparison
   119	and the affine same-carrier comparison agree on the second projection — both are
   120	`(snd C (overSpec k B)).left`.
   121	
   122	Term-mode by necessity: the identity base change spells its codomain `(𝟭 _).obj C`, so `rw`
   123	reports "did not find an occurrence" on a goal that visibly contains the pattern (the R4/R5
   124	spelling friction of I-0216, measured here). -/
   125	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd (k : Type u) [Field k]
   126	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   127	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
   128	    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
   129	        ≫ (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left
   130	      = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
   131	          ≫ (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
   132	  calc
   133	    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left ≫
   134	        (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
   135	      (snd ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
   136	      Over.whiskerRight_left_snd ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
   137	    _ = (snd C (overSpec k B)).left := rfl
   138	    _ = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv ≫
   139	        (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
   140	      (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k k C B).symm

   143	/-- The inverse cross-base comparison and the whiskered identity base-change comparison
   144	agree on the first projection. -/
   145	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst (k : Type u) [Field k]
   146	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   147	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
   148	    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
   149	        ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
   150	      (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
   151	        ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
   152	  haveI : IsIso
   153	      (Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   154	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) := by
   155	    rw [← baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left k C]
   156	    exact ((Over.forget _).mapIso ((baseChange.idIso k).app C)).isIso_hom
   157	  apply (cancel_mono
   158	    (Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   159	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))))).1
   160	  have hunit :
   161	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   162	          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   163	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   164	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
   165	        (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
   166	    have hcancel : ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left ≫
   167	        ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left = 𝟙 _ :=
   168	      Over.inv_left_hom_left ((baseChange.idIso k).app C)
   169	    calc
   170	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   171	            ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   172	          Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   173	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
   174	        (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   175	          (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left ≫
   176	            ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left) := by
   177	        rw [← baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left, Category.assoc]
   178	        rfl
   179	      _ = (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫ 𝟙 _ :=
   180	        congrArg (fun q =>
   181	          (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫ q) hcancel
   182	      _ = (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
   183	        Category.comp_id _
   184	  have hunit' :
   185	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   186	          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   187	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   188	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
   189	        (fst C (overSpec k B)).left := by
   190	    simpa only [Functor.id_obj] using hunit
   191	  calc
   192	    ((((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
   193	          ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left) ≫
   194	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   195	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) =
   196	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   197	          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   198	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   199	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) :=
   200	      congrArg (fun q => q ≫ Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   201	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))))
   202	        (Over.whiskerRight_left_fst ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
   203	    _ = (fst C (overSpec k B)).left := hunit'
   204	    _ = ((crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv ≫
   205	          (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left) ≫
   206	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   207	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by
   208	      rw [Category.assoc, crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst]

   213	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight (k : Type u) [Field k]

   222	/-! ## Composite base change
   223	
   224	The tower cocycle needs the projection formula for mathlib's adjunction-defined
   225	`Over.pullbackComp`.  We derive it from the counit characterization of conjugate
   226	natural transformations, then transport it across the proof-bearing equality used by
   227	the frozen `baseChange.compIso` spelling. -/
   228	
   229	open Limits in
   230	private theorem pullbackComp_hom_app_left_fst_fst.{w} {D : Type w}
   231	    [Category.{u} D] [HasPullbacks D] {X Y Z : D}
   232	    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (A : Over Z) :
   233	    ((Over.pullbackComp f g).hom.app A).left ≫
   234	        pullback.fst (pullback.snd A.hom g) f ≫ pullback.fst A.hom g =
   235	      pullback.fst A.hom (f ≫ g) := by
   236	  have h := conjugateEquiv_counit (Over.mapPullbackAdj (f ≫ g))
   237	    ((Over.mapPullbackAdj f).comp (Over.mapPullbackAdj g)) (Over.mapComp f g).inv A
   238	  have hl := congrArg Over.Hom.left h
   239	  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Over.map_map_left, Adjunction.comp_counit_app,
   240	    Over.comp_left, Over.mapPullbackAdj_counit_app, Over.homMk_left,
   241	    Over.mapComp_inv_app_left] at hl
   242	  change (((conjugateEquiv (Over.mapPullbackAdj (f ≫ g))
   243	    ((Over.mapPullbackAdj f).comp (Over.mapPullbackAdj g)))
   244	      (Over.mapComp f g).inv).app A).left ≫
   245	      pullback.fst (pullback.snd A.hom g) f ≫ pullback.fst A.hom g = _
   246	  exact hl.trans (Category.id_comp _)

   252	    (h : Over.pullback fg = Over.pullback (f ≫ g)) (A : Over Z) :
   253	    ((eqToIso h ≪≫ Over.pullbackComp f g).hom.app A).left ≫
   254	        pullback.fst (pullback.snd A.hom g) f ≫ pullback.fst A.hom g =
   255	      pullback.fst A.hom fg := by
   256	  subst fg
   257	  have hh : h = rfl := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   258	  cases hh
   259	  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_refl,
   260	    Over.comp_left, Category.id_comp] using pullbackComp_hom_app_left_fst_fst f g A

   308	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
   309	/-- The inverse affine same-carrier comparison over `k → M` is the composite of the
   310	comparisons over `k → L` and `L → M`, followed by transport along the inverse
   311	`baseChange.compIso`. -/
   312	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_tower
   313	    (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
   314	    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M]
   315	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
   316	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra L B] [Algebra M B]
   317	    [IsScalarTower k L B] [IsScalarTower L M B] [IsScalarTower k M B] :
   318	    (crossBaseAffineIso k M C B).inv =
   319	      (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).inv ≫
   320	        (crossBaseAffineIso L M ((baseChange k L).obj C) B).inv ≫
   321	          (((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv ▷ overSpec M B).left := by
   322	  let CL := (baseChange k L).obj C
   323	  let CLM := (baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C
   324	  let CM := (baseChange k M).obj C
   325	  let eKM : (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left ⟶ (CM ⊗ overSpec M B).left :=
   326	    (crossBaseAffineIso k M C B).inv
   327	  let eKL : (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left ⟶ (CL ⊗ overSpec L B).left :=
   328	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).inv
   329	  let eLM : (CL ⊗ overSpec L B).left ⟶ (CLM ⊗ overSpec M B).left :=
   330	    (crossBaseAffineIso L M CL B).inv
   331	  let g : (CLM ⊗ overSpec M B).left ⟶ (CM ⊗ overSpec M B).left :=
   332	    (((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv ▷ overSpec M B).left
   333	  let fM : (CM ⊗ overSpec M B).left ⟶ CM.left :=
   334	    (fst CM (overSpec M B)).left
   335	  let fLM : (CLM ⊗ overSpec M B).left ⟶ CLM.left :=
   336	    (fst CLM (overSpec M B)).left
   337	  let fL : (CL ⊗ overSpec L B).left ⟶ CL.left :=
   338	    (fst CL (overSpec L B)).left
   339	  let fk : (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left ⟶ C.left :=
   340	    (fst C (overSpec k B)).left
   341	  let sM : (CM ⊗ overSpec M B).left ⟶ Spec (.of B) :=
   342	    (snd CM (overSpec M B)).left
   343	  let sLM : (CLM ⊗ overSpec M B).left ⟶ Spec (.of B) :=
   344	    (snd CLM (overSpec M B)).left
   345	  let sL : (CL ⊗ overSpec L B).left ⟶ Spec (.of B) :=
   346	    (snd CL (overSpec L B)).left
   347	  let sk : (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left ⟶ Spec (.of B) :=
   348	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   349	  let pKM : CM.left ⟶ C.left :=
   350	    Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   351	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k M)))
   352	  let pLM : CLM.left ⟶ CL.left :=
   353	    Limits.pullback.fst CL.hom
   354	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L M)))
   355	  let pKL : CL.left ⟶ C.left :=
   356	    Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   357	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))
   358	  let qKM : CM.left ⟶ Spec (.of M) :=
   359	    Limits.pullback.snd C.hom
   360	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k M)))
   361	  let bM : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of M) := (overSpec M B).hom
   362	  let c : CLM.left ⟶ CM.left :=
   363	    ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv.left
   364	  change eKM = eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g
   365	  have hsKM : eKM ≫ sM = sk :=
   366	    crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k M C B
   367	  have hsKL : eKL ≫ sL = sk :=
   368	    crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k L C B
   369	  have hsLM : eLM ≫ sLM = sL :=
   370	    crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd L M CL B
   371	  have hgs : g ≫ sM = sLM :=
   372	    Over.whiskerRight_left_snd ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv
   373	  have hsnd : eKM ≫ sM = (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ sM := by
   374	    apply hsKM.trans
   375	    symm
   376	    calc
   377	      (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ sM = eKL ≫ (eLM ≫ (g ≫ sM)) := by
   378	        simp only [Category.assoc]
   379	      _ = eKL ≫ (eLM ≫ sLM) :=
   380	        congrArg (fun q => eKL ≫ (eLM ≫ q)) hgs
   381	      _ = eKL ≫ sL := congrArg (fun q => eKL ≫ q) hsLM
   382	      _ = sk := hsKL
   383	  have hKM : eKM ≫ fM ≫ pKM = fk :=
   384	    crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst k M C B
   385	  have hKL : eKL ≫ fL ≫ pKL = fk :=
   386	    crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst k L C B
   387	  have hLM : eLM ≫ fLM ≫ pLM = fL :=
   388	    crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst L M CL B
   389	  have hgf : g ≫ fM = fLM ≫ c :=
   390	    Over.whiskerRight_left_fst ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv
   391	  have hc : c ≫ pKM = pLM ≫ pKL :=
   392	    baseChange_compIso_inv_app_left_fst_fst k L M C
   393	  have hprojC :
   394	      (eKM ≫ fM) ≫ pKM = ((eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ fM) ≫ pKM := by
   395	    apply hKM.trans
   396	    calc
   397	      fk = eKL ≫ fL ≫ pKL := hKL.symm
   398	      _ = eKL ≫ (eLM ≫ fLM ≫ pLM) ≫ pKL :=
   399	        congrArg (fun q => eKL ≫ q ≫ pKL) hLM.symm
   400	      _ = eKL ≫ eLM ≫ fLM ≫ (pLM ≫ pKL) := by
   401	        simp only [Category.assoc]
   402	      _ = eKL ≫ eLM ≫ fLM ≫ (c ≫ pKM) :=
   403	        congrArg (fun q => eKL ≫ eLM ≫ fLM ≫ q) hc.symm
   404	      _ = eKL ≫ eLM ≫ (fLM ≫ c) ≫ pKM := by
   405	        simp only [Category.assoc]
   406	      _ = eKL ≫ eLM ≫ (g ≫ fM) ≫ pKM :=
   407	        congrArg (fun q => eKL ≫ eLM ≫ q ≫ pKM) hgf.symm
   408	      _ = ((eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ fM) ≫ pKM := by
   409	        simp only [Category.assoc]
   410	  have hprod : fM ≫ qKM = sM ≫ bM :=
   411	    (Over.isPullback_left CM (overSpec M B)).w
   412	  have hprojM :
   413	      (eKM ≫ fM) ≫ qKM = ((eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ fM) ≫ qKM := by
   414	    calc
   415	      (eKM ≫ fM) ≫ qKM = eKM ≫ (sM ≫ bM) :=
   416	        (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
   417	          (congrArg (fun q => eKM ≫ q) hprod)
   418	      _ = (eKM ≫ sM) ≫ bM := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
   419	      _ = ((eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ sM) ≫ bM :=
   420	        congrArg (fun q => q ≫ bM) hsnd
   421	      _ = (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ (sM ≫ bM) :=
   422	        Category.assoc _ _ _
   423	      _ = ((eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ fM) ≫ qKM :=
   424	        ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
   425	          (congrArg (fun q => (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ q) hprod)).symm
   426	  have hfst : eKM ≫ fM = (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ fM := by
   427	    apply Limits.pullback.hom_ext
   428	    · exact hprojC
   429	    · exact hprojM
   430	  apply (Over.isPullback_left CM (overSpec M B)).hom_ext
   431	  · exact hfst
   432	  · exact hsnd

   434	/-- The inverse affine base-field shuffle over a scalar tower is the composite of the two
   435	successive inverse shuffles and transport along the frozen curve comparison. -/
   436	theorem PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle_symm_tower
   437	    (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
   438	    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M]
   439	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
   440	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra L B] [Algebra M B]
   441	    [IsScalarTower k L B] [IsScalarTower L M B] [IsScalarTower k M B]
   442	    (a : PicEtAff ((baseChange k M).obj C) B) :
   443	    (PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k M C B).symm a =
   444	      (PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k L C B).symm
   445	        ((PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle L M ((baseChange k L).obj C) B).symm
   446	          (PicEtAff.curveMap B ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv a)) := by
   447	  let g : (baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C) ⟶ (baseChange k M).obj C :=
   448	    ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv
   449	  change (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k M C).picEtAffHom B a =
   450	    (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).picEtAffHom B
   451	      ((crossBaseTransportFamilyInv L M ((baseChange k L).obj C)).picEtAffHom B
   452	        ((curveTransportFamily g).picEtAffHom B a))
   453	  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
   454	  | mk U x =>
   455	    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk,
   456	      RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk]
   457	    refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk C U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
   458	    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe, RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe,
   459	      RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe, RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe]
   460	    generalize (x : relPic ((baseChange k M).obj C) (overSpec M U.Carrier)) = y
   461	    induction y using relPic.ind with
   462	    | mk Λ =>
   463	      rw [RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk,
   464	        RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk]
   465	      refine congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k U.Carrier)) ?_
   466	      rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply,
   467	        ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   468	        crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom, crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom,
   469	        crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom, curveTransportFamily_hom,
   470	        crossBaseAffineIso_inv_tower k L M C U.Carrier]
   471	      dsimp [g]
   472	      rw [Category.assoc]
   473	      rfl

    10	/-!
    11	# W7-B4a: field-point matching and the same-`K` degree comparison (θ groundwork)
    12	
    13	Wave-7 brick B-4a (`informal/w7-worksheet.md` §D2 row W7-B4a): the two ingredients of the
    14	degree-zero restriction of the base-field comparison θ (B-4b) that are independent of the
    15	étale-plus shuffle (B-2).  Throughout, `k → L` is a field embedding,
    16	`σ = Spec.map (algebraMap k L)`, `C_L = (baseChange k L).obj C`.
    17	
    18	**1. The same-carrier comparison and its degree invariance.**  For a test algebra `A` in
    19	a scalar tower `k → L → A`, B-1's `crossBaseIso` at `T = overSpec L A` composed with the
    20	whiskered affine matching `mapOverSpecIso` gives `crossBaseAffineIso :
    21	(C_L ⊗_L overSpec L A).left ≅ (C ⊗_k overSpec k A).left`, commuting with the second
    22	projections (`crossBaseAffineIso_hom_snd`) and natural in `A` against `Over.overSpecMap`
    23	(`crossBaseAffineIso_naturality`).  It descends to the relative Picard groups
    24	(`relPicCrossBase`/`relPicCrossBaseEquiv`, with the `relPicAlgMap` square — the relPic
    25	layer of the B-2 shuffle).  At a *field* `K` in the tower, both sides carry the
    26	`Curve/BaseChangeInstances` snd-structure over `Spec K`, so B-3's engine applies:
    27	`classDeg_cechPicMap_crossBaseAffineIso` and the **keystone
    28	`relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase`** — `relPicDeg K` reads the same integer on the two
    29	presentations of the fiber.  Per the deg-d5b D1 discipline this is the *only* licensed
    30	cross-presentation degree seam: B-4b degree facts route through it and E-iv-alg.
    31	
    32	**2. Field-point matching (the R5 brick).**  `k`-field-points of the pushed-forward test
    33	`(Over.map σ).obj T` correspond to `L`-field-points of `T` plus the scalar-tower
    34	structure: `pushFieldPoint` (pack, through `mapOverSpecIso`);
    35	`fieldPointAlgebra`/`isScalarTower_fieldPointAlgebra`/`liftFieldPoint` (unpack, via
    36	`Spec.preimage` of `t.left ≫ T.hom`); round trips with no heterogeneous equality
    37	anywhere — the quantifier trap (recon risk R5) is dodged by quantifying over both
    38	algebra structures plus the tower.  Consumable forms for B-4b's degree-zero restriction:
    39	`mem_pic0Subgroup_iff_forall_pushFieldPoint` (the quantifier exchange) and the
    40	**keystone `mem_pic0Subgroup_iff_of_degAt_pushFieldPoint_eq`** — classes matching in
    41	degree at all pushed field-point pairs are simultaneously degree-zero, so θ's
    42	restriction to `pic0Subgroup` reduces to the `degAt` matching that B-2 plus the degree
    43	seam supply.
    44	-/

    55	/-! ## The same-`K` comparison isomorphism at affine tests -/
    56	
    57	section CrossBaseAffine
    58	
    59	variable (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    60	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    61	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower k L A]
    62	
    63	/-- **The same-carrier comparison at an affine test in the tower `k → L → A`**: the
    64	base-changed curve tensored (over `L`) with `Spec A` is the original curve tensored
    65	(over `k`) with `Spec A` — B-1's cross-base square `crossBaseIso` at `T = overSpec L A`,
    66	composed with the whiskering of the affine matching `mapOverSpecIso`. -/
    67	noncomputable def crossBaseAffineIso :
    68	    (((baseChange k L).obj C) ⊗ overSpec L A).left ≅ (C ⊗ overSpec k A).left :=
    69	  crossBaseIso k L C (overSpec L A) ≪≫
    70	    (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapIso (whiskerLeftIso C (mapOverSpecIso k L A))
    71	
    72	/-- The `hom` of the same-carrier comparison, unfolded (each factor is definitional). -/
    73	lemma crossBaseAffineIso_hom :
    74	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom
    75	      = (crossBaseIso k L C (overSpec L A)).hom
    76	          ≫ (C ◁ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).hom).left :=
    77	  rfl
    78	
    79	/-- **The same-carrier comparison commutes with the second projections**: it is a
    80	morphism of curve bundles over `Spec A` (in particular, over `Spec K` at a field test,
    81	which is what feeds B-3's degree engine). -/
    82	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    83	lemma crossBaseAffineIso_hom_snd :
    84	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom ≫ (snd C (overSpec k A)).left
    85	      = (snd ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left := by
    86	  have h1 : (C ◁ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).hom).left ≫ (snd C (overSpec k A)).left
    87	      = (snd C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj
    88	          (overSpec L A))).left ≫ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).hom.left := by
    89	    rw [← Over.comp_left, whiskerLeft_snd, Over.comp_left]
    90	  rw [crossBaseAffineIso_hom, Category.assoc, h1]
    91	  exact (Over.crossBaseIso_hom_snd_assoc
    92	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))) C (overSpec L A)
    93	    ((mapOverSpecIso k L A).hom.left)).trans (Category.comp_id _)
    94	
    95	/-- The inverse of the same-carrier comparison commutes with the second projections. -/
    96	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    97	lemma crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd :
    98	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv
    99	        ≫ (snd ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left
   100	      = (snd C (overSpec k A)).left :=
   101	  (Iso.inv_comp_eq _).mpr (crossBaseAffineIso_hom_snd k L C A).symm
   102	
   103	/-- **Naturality of the same-carrier comparison in the test algebra**: for an `L`-algebra
   104	map `f : A →ₐ[L] B` in towers over `k`, the comparisons intertwine `Spec f` whiskered on
   105	the two sides (`Over.overSpecMap` of `f` over `L`, resp. of its scalar restriction over
   106	`k`). -/
   107	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_naturality (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   108	    [Algebra L B] [IsScalarTower k L B] (f : A →ₐ[L] B) :
   109	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).hom
   110	        ≫ (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k)).left
   111	      = (((baseChange k L).obj C) ◁ Over.overSpecMap f).left
   112	          ≫ (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom := by
   113	  have hsq : (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).map
   114	        (Over.overSpecMap f) ≫ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).hom
   115	      = (mapOverSpecIso k L B).hom ≫ Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k) := by
   116	    refine Over.OverMorphism.ext ?_
   117	    exact (Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm
   118	  have hwhisker : (C ◁ (mapOverSpecIso k L B).hom).left
   119	        ≫ (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k)).left
   120	      = (C ◁ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).map
   121	            (Over.overSpecMap f)).left
   122	          ≫ (C ◁ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).hom).left := by
   123	    rw [← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp,
   124	      ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp, hsq]
   125	  rw [crossBaseAffineIso_hom, crossBaseAffineIso_hom, Category.assoc, hwhisker,
   126	    ← Category.assoc, ← crossBaseIso_naturality k L C (Over.overSpecMap f),
   127	    Category.assoc]
   128	
   129	/-! ### Descent to the relative Picard groups -/
   130	
   131	/-- Transport along the same-carrier comparison sends classes pulled back from `Spec A`
   132	(over `k`) to classes pulled back from `Spec A` (over `L`): well-definedness of
   133	`relPicCrossBase` on the `picFromBase` cosets. -/
   134	lemma picFromBase_le_comap_crossBaseAffineIso :
   135	    picFromBase C (overSpec k A)
   136	      ≤ (picFromBase ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).comap
   137	          (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom) := by
   138	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
   139	  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
   140	  show CechPic.map (snd ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left N
   141	      = CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom
   142	          (CechPic.map (snd C (overSpec k A)).left N)
   143	  calc CechPic.map (snd ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left N
   144	      = CechPic.map ((crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom ≫ (snd C (overSpec k A)).left) N :=
   145	        congrArg (fun φ => CechPic.map φ N) (crossBaseAffineIso_hom_snd k L C A).symm
   146	    _ = CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom
   147	          (CechPic.map (snd C (overSpec k A)).left N) := by
   148	        rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]; rfl
   149	
   150	/-- Transport along the inverse comparison sends classes pulled back from `Spec A`
   151	(over `L`) to classes pulled back from `Spec A` (over `k`). -/
   152	lemma picFromBase_le_comap_crossBaseAffineIso_inv :
   153	    picFromBase ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)
   154	      ≤ (picFromBase C (overSpec k A)).comap
   155	          (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv) := by
   156	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
   157	  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
   158	  show CechPic.map (snd C (overSpec k A)).left N
   159	      = CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv
   160	          (CechPic.map (snd ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left N)
   161	  calc CechPic.map (snd C (overSpec k A)).left N
   162	      = CechPic.map ((crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv
   163	          ≫ (snd ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left) N :=
   164	        congrArg (fun φ => CechPic.map φ N) (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k L C A).symm
   165	    _ = CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv
   166	          (CechPic.map (snd ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left N) := by
   167	        rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]; rfl
   168	
   169	/-- **The relPic-level base-field shuffle at an affine test** (the relPic layer of the
   170	B-2 comparison): transport of relative Picard classes along the same-carrier comparison,
   171	`relPic C (overSpec k A) →* relPic C_L (overSpec L A)`. -/
   172	noncomputable def relPicCrossBase :
   173	    relPic C (overSpec k A) →* relPic ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A) :=
   174	  QuotientGroup.map _ _ (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom)
   175	    (picFromBase_le_comap_crossBaseAffineIso k L C A)
   176	
   177	@[simp]
   178	lemma relPicCrossBase_mk (Λ : (C ⊗ overSpec k A).left.CechPic) :
   179	    relPicCrossBase k L C A (relPicMk C (overSpec k A) Λ)
   180	      = relPicMk ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)
   181	          (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom Λ) :=
   182	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ Λ
   183	
   184	/-- The inverse relPic-level shuffle, along the inverse comparison. -/
   185	noncomputable def relPicCrossBaseInv :
   186	    relPic ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A) →* relPic C (overSpec k A) :=
   187	  QuotientGroup.map _ _ (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv)
   188	    (picFromBase_le_comap_crossBaseAffineIso_inv k L C A)
   189	
   190	@[simp]
   191	lemma relPicCrossBaseInv_mk
   192	    (Λ : (((baseChange k L).obj C) ⊗ overSpec L A).left.CechPic) :
   193	    relPicCrossBaseInv k L C A (relPicMk ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A) Λ)
   194	      = relPicMk C (overSpec k A) (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv Λ) :=
   195	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ Λ
   196	
   197	/-- **The relPic-level base-field shuffle is an isomorphism** — the two-sided form that
   198	the B-2 étale-plus shuffle instantiates cover-wise. -/
   199	noncomputable def relPicCrossBaseEquiv :
   200	    relPic C (overSpec k A) ≃* relPic ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A) where
   201	  toFun := relPicCrossBase k L C A
   202	  invFun := relPicCrossBaseInv k L C A
   203	  left_inv x := by
   204	    induction x using relPic.ind with
   205	    | mk Λ =>
   206	      rw [relPicCrossBase_mk, relPicCrossBaseInv_mk]
   207	      refine congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k A)) ?_
   208	      calc CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv
   209	            (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom Λ)
   210	          = CechPic.map ((crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv
   211	              ≫ (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom) Λ := by
   212	            rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]; rfl
   213	        _ = CechPic.map (𝟙 ((C ⊗ overSpec k A).left)) Λ := by rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
   214	        _ = Λ := by
   215	            rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_id]; rfl
   216	  right_inv x := by
   217	    induction x using relPic.ind with
   218	    | mk Λ =>
   219	      rw [relPicCrossBaseInv_mk, relPicCrossBase_mk]
   220	      refine congrArg (relPicMk ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)) ?_
   221	      calc CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom
   222	            (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv Λ)
   223	          = CechPic.map ((crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom
   224	              ≫ (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv) Λ := by
   225	            rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]; rfl
   226	        _ = CechPic.map (𝟙 ((((baseChange k L).obj C) ⊗ overSpec L A).left)) Λ := by
   227	            rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
   228	        _ = Λ := by
   229	            rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_id]; rfl
   230	  map_mul' := map_mul (relPicCrossBase k L C A)
   231	
   232	@[simp]
   233	lemma relPicCrossBaseEquiv_apply (x : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
   234	    relPicCrossBaseEquiv k L C A x = relPicCrossBase k L C A x :=
   235	  rfl
   236	
   237	@[simp]
   238	lemma relPicCrossBaseEquiv_symm_apply
   239	    (y : relPic ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)) :
   240	    (relPicCrossBaseEquiv k L C A).symm y = relPicCrossBaseInv k L C A y :=
   241	  rfl
   242	
   243	/-- **Naturality of the relPic-level shuffle in the test algebra** against the
   244	restriction maps `relPicAlgMap`: for `f : A →ₐ[L] B` in towers over `k`, restricting then
   245	shuffling is shuffling then restricting.  This is the square the B-2 étale-plus shuffle
   246	transports through `mk`/`descentMap`. -/
   247	theorem relPicCrossBase_relPicAlgMap (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   248	    [Algebra L B] [IsScalarTower k L B] (f : A →ₐ[L] B) (x : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
   249	    relPicCrossBase k L C B (relPicAlgMap C (f.restrictScalars k) x)
   250	      = relPicAlgMap ((baseChange k L).obj C) f (relPicCrossBase k L C A x) := by
   251	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   252	  | mk Λ =>
   253	    have h1 : relPicAlgMap C (f.restrictScalars k) (relPicMk C (overSpec k A) Λ)
   254	        = relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
   255	            (CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k)).left) Λ) :=
   256	      relPicMap_mk C (Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k)) Λ
   257	    have h2 : relPicAlgMap ((baseChange k L).obj C) f
   258	          (relPicMk ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)
   259	            (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom Λ))
   260	        = relPicMk ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L B)
   261	            (CechPic.map ((((baseChange k L).obj C) ◁ Over.overSpecMap f).left)
   262	              (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom Λ)) :=
   263	      relPicMap_mk ((baseChange k L).obj C) (Over.overSpecMap f) _
   264	    rw [h1, relPicCrossBase_mk, relPicCrossBase_mk, h2]
   265	    refine congrArg (relPicMk ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L B)) ?_
   266	    calc CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).hom
   267	          (CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k)).left) Λ)
   268	        = CechPic.map ((crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).hom
   269	            ≫ (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k)).left) Λ := by
   270	          rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]; rfl
   271	      _ = CechPic.map ((((baseChange k L).obj C) ◁ Over.overSpecMap f).left
   272	            ≫ (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom) Λ := by
   273	          rw [crossBaseAffineIso_naturality k L C A B f]
   274	      _ = CechPic.map ((((baseChange k L).obj C) ◁ Over.overSpecMap f).left)
   275	            (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).hom Λ) := by
   276	          rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_comp]; rfl
   277	
   278	end CrossBaseAffine

   280	/-! ## The degree matching through B-3 -/
   281	
   282	section DegreeMatching
   283	
   284	variable (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   285	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   286	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   287	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower k L K]
   288	
   289	/-- **Degree invariance along the same-carrier comparison** (B-3 fed with B-1): at a
   290	field test `K` in the tower `k → L → K`, both fibers carry the `BaseChangeInstances`
   291	snd-structure over `Spec K`, the comparison is an isomorphism over `Spec K`
   292	(`crossBaseAffineIso_hom_snd`), and B-3's engine `classDeg_cechPicMap_of_isIso` gives
   293	invariance of `classDeg K` under the transport. -/
   294	theorem classDeg_cechPicMap_crossBaseAffineIso (Λ : (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.CechPic) :
   295	    classDeg K (CechPic.map (crossBaseAffineIso k L C K).hom Λ) = classDeg K Λ :=
   296	  classDeg_cechPicMap_of_isIso K (crossBaseAffineIso k L C K).hom
   297	    (crossBaseAffineIso_hom_snd k L C K) Λ
   298	
   299	/-- **W7-B4a degree-matching keystone**: the relative degree over `K` is invariant under
   300	the relPic-level base-field shuffle — a relative Picard class of the `k`-curve at the
   301	test `K` and its shuffled presentation on the `L`-curve read the same integer.  This is
   302	the degree seam through which the B-2/B-4b `degAt` matching routes (deg-d5b D1: through
   303	B-3 + E-iv-alg only). -/
   304	theorem relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase (x : relPic C (overSpec k K)) :
   305	    relPicDeg K (relPicCrossBase k L C K x) = relPicDeg K x := by
   306	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   307	  | mk Λ =>
   308	    rw [relPicCrossBase_mk, relPicDeg_relPicMk, relPicDeg_relPicMk,
   309	      classDeg_cechPicMap_crossBaseAffineIso]
   310	
   311	end DegreeMatching

   313	/-! ## Field-point matching (the R5 brick) -/
   314	
   315	section FieldPoint
   316	
   317	variable {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   318	variable {T : Over (Spec (.of L))} {K : Type u} [Field K]
   319	
   320	variable (k) in
   321	/-- **Pack direction of the field-point matching**: an `L`-field-point of `T` in a scalar
   322	tower `k → L → K` pushes forward to a `k`-field-point of `(Over.map σ).obj T`, through
   323	the affine matching `mapOverSpecIso`. -/
   324	noncomputable def pushFieldPoint [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower k L K]
   325	    (s : overSpec L K ⟶ T) :
   326	    overSpec k K ⟶ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T :=
   327	  (mapOverSpecIso k L K).inv
   328	    ≫ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).map s
   329	
   330	@[simp]
   331	lemma pushFieldPoint_left [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower k L K]
   332	    (s : overSpec L K ⟶ T) :
   333	    (pushFieldPoint k s).left = s.left :=
   334	  Category.id_comp s.left
   335	
   336	/-- **Unpack direction, the algebra structure**: a `k`-field-point
   337	`t : overSpec k K ⟶ (Over.map σ).obj T` makes `K` an `L`-algebra, via `Spec.preimage` of
   338	the composite `Spec K ⟶ T.left ⟶ Spec L`. -/
   339	@[reducible]
   340	noncomputable def fieldPointAlgebra [Algebra k K]
   341	    (t : overSpec k K
   342	      ⟶ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) :
   343	    Algebra L K :=
   344	  ((Spec.preimage (t.left ≫ T.hom)).hom).toAlgebra
   345	
   346	/-- The algebra map of the unpacked `L`-algebra structure is the `Spec.preimage` of the
   347	composite point (definitional anchor). -/
   348	lemma fieldPointAlgebra_algebraMap [Algebra k K]
   349	    (t : overSpec k K
   350	      ⟶ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) :
   351	    letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   352	    algebraMap L K = (Spec.preimage (t.left ≫ T.hom)).hom :=
   353	  rfl
   354	
   355	/-- **Unpack direction, the tower**: the unpacked `L`-algebra structure on `K` is
   356	compatible with the given `k`-structures — `Spec` of the tower identity is the
   357	`Over`-triangle of `t`. -/
   358	theorem isScalarTower_fieldPointAlgebra [Algebra k K]
   359	    (t : overSpec k K
   360	      ⟶ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) :
   361	    letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   362	    IsScalarTower k L K := by
   363	  letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   364	  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' ?_
   365	  have hw : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)
   366	        ≫ Spec.preimage (t.left ≫ T.hom))
   367	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) := by
   368	    rw [Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_preimage, Category.assoc]
   369	    exact Over.w t
   370	  have hring := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Spec.map_injective hw)
   371	  rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at hring
   372	  exact hring.symm
   373	
   374	/-- **Unpack direction, the point**: a `k`-field-point of `(Over.map σ).obj T` is an
   375	`L`-field-point of `T` on the same carrier morphism, over the unpacked `L`-algebra
   376	structure. -/
   377	noncomputable def liftFieldPoint [Algebra k K]
   378	    (t : overSpec k K
   379	      ⟶ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) :
   380	    letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   381	    overSpec L K ⟶ T :=
   382	  letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   383	  Over.homMk t.left (Spec.map_preimage (t.left ≫ T.hom)).symm
   384	
   385	@[simp]
   386	lemma liftFieldPoint_left [Algebra k K]
   387	    (t : overSpec k K
   388	      ⟶ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) :
   389	    (liftFieldPoint t).left = t.left :=
   390	  rfl
   391	
   392	/-- **Round trip at a `k`-point**: pushing the lifted `L`-point forward recovers the
   393	`k`-point (under the unpacked algebra structure and tower). -/
   394	theorem pushFieldPoint_liftFieldPoint [Algebra k K]
   395	    (t : overSpec k K
   396	      ⟶ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) :
   397	    letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   398	    haveI := isScalarTower_fieldPointAlgebra t
   399	    pushFieldPoint k (liftFieldPoint t) = t := by
   400	  letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   401	  haveI := isScalarTower_fieldPointAlgebra t
   402	  refine Over.OverMorphism.ext ?_
   403	  rw [pushFieldPoint_left, liftFieldPoint_left]
   404	
   405	/-- **Round trip at an `L`-point, the algebra**: unpacking the pushed-forward point
   406	recovers the given `L`-algebra structure. -/
   407	theorem fieldPointAlgebra_pushFieldPoint [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K]
   408	    [IsScalarTower k L K] (s : overSpec L K ⟶ T) :
   409	    fieldPointAlgebra (pushFieldPoint k s) = ‹Algebra L K› := by
   410	  have h : ((pushFieldPoint k s).left ≫ T.hom :
   411	        Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
   412	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L K)) :=
   413	    (congrArg (· ≫ T.hom) (pushFieldPoint_left s)).trans (Over.w s)
   414	  have hpre : Spec.preimage ((pushFieldPoint k s).left ≫ T.hom :
   415	        Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
   416	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L K) :=
   417	    (congrArg Spec.preimage h).trans (Spec.preimage_map _)
   418	  refine Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => ?_
   419	  exact congrArg (fun φ : CommRingCat.of L ⟶ CommRingCat.of K => φ.hom r) hpre
   420	
   421	/-- **Round trip at an `L`-point, the carrier**: lifting the pushed-forward point gives
   422	back the same carrier morphism. -/
   423	@[simp]
   424	theorem liftFieldPoint_pushFieldPoint_left [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K]
   425	    [IsScalarTower k L K] (s : overSpec L K ⟶ T) :
   426	    (liftFieldPoint (pushFieldPoint k s)).left = s.left := by
   427	  rw [liftFieldPoint_left, pushFieldPoint_left]
   428	
   429	end FieldPoint

   431	/-! ## The degree-zero restriction interface for θ -/
   432	
   433	section Pic0Restriction
   434	
   435	variable {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   436	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   437	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   438	variable {T : Over (Spec (.of L))}
   439	
   440	/-- **The quantifier exchange** (the R5 content): a class on the pushed-forward test
   441	`(Over.map σ).obj T` is degree-zero at *every* `k`-field-point iff it is degree-zero at
   442	every *pushed* `L`-field-point — every `k`-field-point of `(Over.map σ).obj T` arises as
   443	`pushFieldPoint` of its own lift, by the round trips. -/
   444	theorem mem_pic0Subgroup_iff_forall_pushFieldPoint
   445	    (lam : picEt C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T)) :
   446	    lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C
   447	        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T)
   448	      ↔ ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower k L K]
   449	          (s : overSpec L K ⟶ T), degAt lam (pushFieldPoint k s) = 0 := by
   450	  constructor
   451	  · intro h K _ _ _ _ s
   452	    exact mem_pic0Subgroup_iff.mp h K (pushFieldPoint k s)
   453	  · intro h
   454	    refine mem_pic0Subgroup_iff.mpr ?_
   455	    intro K _ _ t
   456	    letI := fieldPointAlgebra t
   457	    haveI := isScalarTower_fieldPointAlgebra t
   458	    have heq : pushFieldPoint k (liftFieldPoint t) = t := by
   459	      refine Over.OverMorphism.ext ?_
   460	      rw [pushFieldPoint_left, liftFieldPoint_left]
   461	    have h0 := h K (liftFieldPoint t)
   462	    rwa [heq] at h0
   463	
   464	/-- **The degree-zero restriction engine for θ** (the B-4a → B-4b handshake): if a class
   465	`lam` of the `k`-curve on the pushed-forward test and a class `lamL` of the base-changed
   466	curve on `T` match in degree at every pushed field-point pair, then they are
   467	simultaneously degree-zero.  B-4b discharges the matching hypothesis from the B-2 shuffle
   468	via the degree seam `relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase`, and this equivalence restricts θ to the
   469	degree-zero subfunctors. -/
   470	theorem mem_pic0Subgroup_iff_of_degAt_pushFieldPoint_eq
   471	    {lam : picEt C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T)}
   472	    {lamL : picEt ((baseChange k L).obj C) T}
   473	    (hmatch : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K]
   474	      [IsScalarTower k L K] (s : overSpec L K ⟶ T),
   475	      degAt lam (pushFieldPoint k s) = degAt lamL s) :
   476	    lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C
   477	        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T)
   478	      ↔ lamL ∈ pic0Subgroup ((baseChange k L).obj C) T := by
   479	  rw [mem_pic0Subgroup_iff_forall_pushFieldPoint C lam]
   480	  constructor
   481	  · intro h
   482	    refine mem_pic0Subgroup_iff.mpr ?_
   483	    intro K _ _ s
   484	    letI : Algebra k K := ((algebraMap L K).comp (algebraMap k L)).toAlgebra
   485	    haveI : IsScalarTower k L K := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
   486	    rw [← hmatch K s]
   487	    exact h K s
   488	  · intro h K _ _ _ _ s
   489	    rw [hmatch K s]
   490	    exact mem_pic0Subgroup_iff.mp h K s
   491	
   492	end Pic0Restriction
   493	
   494	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# θ: the base-field comparison of the degree-zero Picard functor (Wave 7, W7-B4b)
    11	
    12	For a field embedding `k → L` and the curve bundle `C` over `k` with base change
    13	`C_L = (baseChange k L).obj C`, the componentwise lift of the B-2 shuffle
    14	(`Picard/PicEtCrossBase.lean`) restricts to the degree-zero subfunctors and assembles
    15	into the natural isomorphism θ of the ratified D2-i shape,
    16	`θ : Pic⁰_{C_L/L} ≅ (Over.map σ)ᵒᵖ ⋙ Pic⁰_{C/k}` in `CommGrpCat`-valued functors
    17	(`σ = Spec.map (algebraMap k L)`).
    18	
    19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.degAff_baseFieldShuffle`: **degree invariance of the B-2 shuffle at
    20	  a field test** — `degAff K (baseFieldShuffle x) = degAff K x` for `K` in the tower
    21	  `k → L → K`.  Both sides are read by `degAff_mk` on a common finite separable
    22	  refinement `M/K` of the representing cover; the readings match through the
    23	  `relPicAlgMap` square `relPicCrossBase_relPicAlgMap` and B-4a's degree seam
    24	  `relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase` at `M` (the deg-d5b D1 discipline: the only licensed
    25	  cross-presentation degree route).
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.degAt_pushFieldPoint_picEtCrossBase`: **the `degAt` matching** —
    27	  the degree of a class on the pushed test at a pushed field point equals the degree of
    28	  its lift at the field point itself, by naturality of the lift, the affine face, and
    29	  the shuffle degree invariance.
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_pic0Subgroup_picEtCrossBase_iff`: **the degree-zero
    31	  restriction** — a class and its lift are simultaneously degree-zero, by B-4a's engine
    32	  `mem_pic0Subgroup_iff_of_degAt_pushFieldPoint_eq` fed with the `degAt` matching.
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0CrossBaseEquiv`: the induced isomorphism of degree-zero
    34	  subgroups `pic⁰(C_L, T) ≃* pic⁰(C, (Over.map σ).obj T)`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0Theta`: **θ** (Wave-7 brick B-4b, worksheet §D2 W7-B4b row) —
    36	  the `CommGrpCat`-valued natural isomorphism
    37	  `pic0Functor C_L ≅ (Over.map σ).op ⋙ pic0Functor C`, with `rfl`-grade component
    38	  anchors `pic0Theta_hom_app_coe`/`pic0Theta_inv_app_coe`.
    39	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0ThetaType`: the Type-valued form, by whiskering with
    40	  `forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat ⋙ forget GrpCat` against `pic0TypeFunctor` (the D2-i
    41	  massage; consumed by B-5's `RepresentableBy.ofIso` transport).
    42	
    43	Everything θ-shaped here is stated for an arbitrary `[Field L] [Algebra k L]` — no
    44	finiteness, separability or Galois content — so composed shuffles at towers
    45	`k → L → M` are legal inputs for the K-1 θ-cocycle.
    46	-/
    47	
    48	set_option autoImplicit false
    49	
    50	universe u
    51	
    52	open CategoryTheory
    53	
    54	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    55	
    56	variable (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    57	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    58	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    59	
    60	/-! ## Degree invariance of the shuffle at a field test -/
    61	
    62	/-- **Degree invariance of the base-field shuffle at a field test** (the B-4b degree
    63	keystone): for a field `K` in the tower `k → L → K`, the B-2 shuffle preserves the
    64	plus-class degree.  Both sides are read by `degAff_mk` on a common finite separable
    65	refinement `M/K` of the representing cover; the readings match through the
    66	`relPicAlgMap` square and B-4a's degree seam `relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase` at `M`. -/
    67	theorem degAff_baseFieldShuffle (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K]
    68	    [IsScalarTower k L K] (x : PicEtAff C K) :
    69	    PicEtAff.degAff K (PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k L C K x) = PicEtAff.degAff K x := by
    70	  induction x using PicEtAff.ind with
    71	  | mk E y =>
    72	    obtain ⟨M, _, _, _, _, ⟨j⟩⟩ := E.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
    73	    letI : Algebra L M := ((algebraMap K M).comp (algebraMap L K)).toAlgebra
    74	    haveI : IsScalarTower L K M := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    75	    letI : Algebra k M := ((algebraMap L M).comp (algebraMap k L)).toAlgebra
    76	    haveI : IsScalarTower k L M := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    77	    haveI : IsScalarTower k K M := .of_algebraMap_eq fun r => by
    78	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k L K r]; rfl
    79	    rw [PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle_mk,
    80	      PicEtAff.degAff_mk E ((crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).descentHom E y) M j,
    81	      PicEtAff.degAff_mk E y M j,
    82	      PicEtAff.crossBaseTransportFamily_descentHom_coe,
    83	      ← relPicCrossBase_relPicAlgMap k L C E.Carrier M (j.restrictScalars L),
    84	      relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase]
    85	    rfl
    86	
    87	/-! ## The `degAt` matching at pushed field points -/
    88	
    89	section DegAtMatching
    90	
    91	variable {T : Over (Spec (.of L))}
    92	
    93	/-- **The `degAt` matching at pushed field points**: the degree of an étale Picard class
    94	of `C` on the pushed test `(Over.map σ).obj T` at a pushed field point is the degree of
    95	its componentwise lift at the field point itself.  Naturality of the lift moves the
    96	restriction to the affine test `overSpec L K`, the affine face identifies the lift with
    97	the B-2 shuffle there, and the shuffle preserves the degree. -/
    98	theorem degAt_pushFieldPoint_picEtCrossBase
    99	    (s : picEt C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T))
   100	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower k L K]
   101	    (t : overSpec L K ⟶ T) :
   102	    degAt s (pushFieldPoint k t) = degAt (picEtCrossBase k L C T s) t :=
   103	  calc degAt s (pushFieldPoint k t)
   104	      = PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K
   105	          (picEtMap C (mapOverSpecIso k L K).inv
   106	            (picEtMap C
   107	              ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).map t) s))) :=
   108	        congrArg (fun z => PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K z))
   109	          (picEtMap_comp C
   110	            ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).map t)
   111	            (mapOverSpecIso k L K).inv s)
   112	    _ = PicEtAff.degAff K (PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k L C K
   113	          (picEtAffineEquiv C K
   114	            (picEtMap C (mapOverSpecIso k L K).inv
   115	              (picEtMap C
   116	                ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).map t)
   117	                s)))) :=
   118	        (degAff_baseFieldShuffle k L C K _).symm
   119	    _ = PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv ((baseChange k L).obj C) K
   120	          (picEtCrossBase k L C (overSpec L K)
   121	            (picEtMap C
   122	              ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).map t) s))) :=
   123	        congrArg (PicEtAff.degAff K)
   124	          (picEtAffineEquiv_picEtCrossBase k L C K _).symm
   125	    _ = degAt (picEtCrossBase k L C T s) t :=
   126	        (congrArg (fun z => PicEtAff.degAff K
   127	            (picEtAffineEquiv ((baseChange k L).obj C) K z))
   128	          (picEtMap_picEtCrossBase k L C t s)).symm
   129	
   130	/-! ## The degree-zero restriction -/
   131	
   132	/-- **The degree-zero restriction of the componentwise lift** (the B-4a → B-4b
   133	handshake discharged): an étale Picard class of `C` on the pushed test and its

+/-!
+# Projection coherence for the degree-zero Picard base-change comparison
+
+This file supplies the scheme-level equalities used to compare the affine transport
+families underlying `pic0Theta`. It proves that the inverse same-carrier comparison has
+the expected first projection over any field extension, and identifies the whole
+comparison at the identity extension with whiskering by `baseChange.idIso`.
+
+The proof keeps the proof-bearing `eqToIso` in `baseChange.idIso` opaque. Its component
+projection is obtained from adjunction conjugation and proof irrelevance, avoiding a
+large simplifier expansion of `Over.pullbackId`.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+/-! ## Congruence of étale-plus transports (the reduction key)
+
+Both the base-field shuffle (`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle`, via `crossBaseTransportFamily`) and
+the curve transport (`PicEtAff.curveMap`, via `curveTransportFamily`) are
+`RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom`s, and `picEtAffHom_mk`/`descentHom_coe`/`relPicHom_mk`
+express the transport as `CechPic.map` of the family's `hom` scheme morphism. Hence two
+families with pointwise-equal `hom` fields induce equal transports — the lemma through which
+the two θ-cocycle atoms reduce to a scheme-morphism identity on the product carriers. -/
+theorem RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_congr {kD kE kT : Type u}
+    [Field kD] [Field kE] [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
+    {D : Over (Spec (.of kD))} {E : Over (Spec (.of kE))}
+    (S T : RelPicTransportFamily kT D E)
+    (h : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
+      [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B], S.hom B = T.hom B)
+    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]
+    [IsScalarTower kD kT A] [IsScalarTower kE kT A] (a : PicEtAff E A) :
+    S.picEtAffHom A a = T.picEtAffHom A a := by
+  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
+  | _ U x =>
+    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk]
+    refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk D U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
+    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe, RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe]
+    generalize (x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)) = y
+    induction y using relPic.ind with
+    | mk L =>
+      rw [RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, h]
+
+/-! ## Base-change-identity/composite pullback helpers -/
+
+open Limits in
+/-- `Over.pullbackId`'s forward comparison has first projection the identity: the
+base-change-along-`𝟙` section reads off the original object on the first factor. -/
+theorem pullbackId_hom_app_left.{w} {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D] [HasPullbacks D]
+    {S : D} (X : Over S) :
+    (Over.pullbackId.hom.app X).left = pullback.fst X.hom (𝟙 S) := by
+  change ((conjugateEquiv (Over.mapPullbackAdj (𝟙 S))
+    (Adjunction.id (C := Over S)) (Over.mapId S).inv).app X).left = _
+  rw [conjugateEquiv_adjunction_id]
+  simp only [Over.comp_left, Over.mapId_inv_app_left,
+    Over.mapPullbackAdj_counit_app, Over.homMk_left]
+  simp
+
+open Limits in
+private theorem pullbackId_transport_hom_app_left.{w}
+    {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D] [HasPullbacks D] {S : D}
+    (f : S ⟶ S) (hf : f = 𝟙 S)
+    (h : Over.pullback f = Over.pullback (𝟙 S)) (X : Over S) :
+    ((eqToIso h ≪≫ Over.pullbackId).hom.app X).left = pullback.fst X.hom f := by
+  subst f
+  have hh : h = rfl := Subsingleton.elim _ _
+  cases hh
+  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_refl,
+    Over.comp_left, Category.id_comp] using pullbackId_hom_app_left X
+
+open Limits in
+/-- The forward identity base-change iso on the frozen `Challenge` spelling has first
+projection `pullback.fst` along the trivial base map. -/
+theorem baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left (k : Type u) [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
+    ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left
+      = pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by
+  unfold baseChange.idIso
+  exact pullbackId_transport_hom_app_left _ (by simp) _ C
+
+open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
+/-- The inverse same-carrier comparison followed by the first projection is the first
+projection of the original curve, after composing with the base-change pullback map. -/
+theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L]
+    [Algebra k L] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
+    [Algebra k A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower k L A] :
+    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv ≫
+        ((fst ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left ≫
+          Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))) =
+      (fst C (overSpec k A)).left := by
+  rw [crossBaseAffineIso, Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv, Category.assoc,
+    Over.crossBaseIso_inv_fst]
+  change (C ◁ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).inv).left ≫
+    (fst C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj
+      (overSpec L A))).left = (fst C (overSpec k A)).left
+  exact Over.whiskerLeft_left_fst (mapOverSpecIso k L A).inv
+
+/-! ## The identity-extension comparison
+
+The K-1a Leg-4 atom is the scheme identity
+`((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv`,
+is proved by `(Over.isPullback_left _ _).hom_ext` on the two projections. -/
+
+open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
+/-- **The `snd` leg of the K-1a Leg-4 atom**: the whiskered identity base-change comparison
+and the affine same-carrier comparison agree on the second projection — both are
+`(snd C (overSpec k B)).left`.
+
+Term-mode by necessity: the identity base change spells its codomain `(𝟭 _).obj C`, so `rw`
+reports "did not find an occurrence" on a goal that visibly contains the pattern (the R4/R5
+spelling friction of I-0216, measured here). -/
+theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd (k : Type u) [Field k]
+    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
+    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
+    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
+        ≫ (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left
+      = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
+          ≫ (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
+  calc
+    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left ≫
+        (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
+      (snd ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
+      Over.whiskerRight_left_snd ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
+    _ = (snd C (overSpec k B)).left := rfl
+    _ = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv ≫
+        (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
+      (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k k C B).symm
+
+open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
+/-- The inverse cross-base comparison and the whiskered identity base-change comparison
+agree on the first projection. -/
+theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst (k : Type u) [Field k]
+    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
+    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
+    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
+        ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
+      (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
+        ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
+  haveI : IsIso
+      (Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) := by
+    rw [← baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left k C]
+    exact ((Over.forget _).mapIso ((baseChange.idIso k).app C)).isIso_hom
+  apply (cancel_mono
+    (Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))))).1
+  have hunit :
+      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
+          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
+        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
+        (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
+    have hcancel : ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left ≫
+        ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left = 𝟙 _ :=
+      Over.inv_left_hom_left ((baseChange.idIso k).app C)
+    calc
+      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
+            ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
+          Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
+        (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
+          (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left ≫
+            ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left) := by
+        rw [← baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left, Category.assoc]
+        rfl
+      _ = (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫ 𝟙 _ :=
+        congrArg (fun q =>
+          (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫ q) hcancel
+      _ = (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
+        Category.comp_id _
+  have hunit' :
+      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
+          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
+        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
+        (fst C (overSpec k B)).left := by
+    simpa only [Functor.id_obj] using hunit
+  calc
+    ((((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
+          ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left) ≫
+        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) =
+      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
+          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
+        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) :=
+      congrArg (fun q => q ≫ Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))))
+        (Over.whiskerRight_left_fst ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
+    _ = (fst C (overSpec k B)).left := hunit'
+    _ = ((crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv ≫
+          (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left) ≫
+        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
+          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by
+      rw [Category.assoc, crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst]
+
+open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
+/-- The inverse same-carrier comparison at the identity field extension is exactly
+whiskering by the inverse identity base-change comparison. -/
+theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight (k : Type u) [Field k]
+    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
+    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
+    (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv =
+      (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left := by
+  apply (Over.isPullback_left ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).hom_ext
+  · exact (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst k C B).symm
+  · exact (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd k C B).symm
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry

+/-- The inverse affine same-carrier comparison over `k → M` is the composite of the
+comparisons over `k → L` and `L → M`, followed by transport along the inverse
+`baseChange.compIso`. -/
+theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_tower
+    (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
+    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M]

+  let CLM := (baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C
+  let CM := (baseChange k M).obj C
+  let eKM : (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left ⟶ (CM ⊗ overSpec M B).left :=
+    (crossBaseAffineIso k M C B).inv
+  let eKL : (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left ⟶ (CL ⊗ overSpec L B).left :=
+    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).inv
+  let eLM : (CL ⊗ overSpec L B).left ⟶ (CLM ⊗ overSpec M B).left :=
+    (crossBaseAffineIso L M CL B).inv
+  let g : (CLM ⊗ overSpec M B).left ⟶ (CM ⊗ overSpec M B).left :=

+  let fLM : (CLM ⊗ overSpec M B).left ⟶ CLM.left :=

+    Over.whiskerRight_left_fst ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv

+        congrArg (fun q => q ≫ bM) hsnd
+      _ = (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ (sM ≫ bM) :=
+        Category.assoc _ _ _
+      _ = ((eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ fM) ≫ qKM :=
+        ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
+          (congrArg (fun q => (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ q) hprod)).symm
+  have hfst : eKM ≫ fM = (eKL ≫ eLM ≫ g) ≫ fM := by
+    apply Limits.pullback.hom_ext
+    · exact hprojC
+    · exact hprojM

+  · exact hsnd
+

     8	/-!
     9	# The base-field comparison of the étale Picard functor on all tests (Wave 7, B-4b lift)
    10	
    11	For a field embedding `k → L`, a curve bundle `C` over `k` with base change
    12	`C_L = (baseChange k L).obj C`, and an `L`-test object `T`, the B-2 base-field shuffle
    13	`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle` lifts componentwise through the affine-opens limit: étale
    14	Picard classes of `C` on the pushed-forward test `(Over.map σ).obj T`
    15	(`σ = Spec.map (algebraMap k L)`) correspond to étale Picard classes of `C_L` on `T`
    16	itself.  The carriers of `T` and `(Over.map σ).obj T` agree definitionally, so the affine
    17	opens are literally shared; the only genuine seam is the section-ring scalar tower.
    18	
    19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isScalarTower_sections_map`: **the section-ring tower seam** —
    20	  the `k`-algebra structure `Over.sectionsAlgebra ((Over.map σ).obj T) U` and the
    21	  `L`-algebra structure `Over.sectionsAlgebra T U` on `Γ(T.left, U)` form a scalar tower
    22	  (`CommRingCat`-level form: `Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections_map`).
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.sectionShuffle`: the B-2 shuffle at the section ring of an open of
    24	  an `L`-test object, with the `k`-structure through the pushforward; the componentwise
    25	  ingredient of θ, with the restriction squares `mapAlg_sectionShuffle`/`_symm` and the
    26	  pullback square `appLE_sectionShuffle` (the `restrictScalars` reconciliations
    27	  `Over.resAlgHom_map_restrictScalars`/`Over.appLEAlgHom_map_restrictScalars` are
    28	  `rfl`-grade).
    29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtCrossBase`/`picEtCrossBaseInv`/`picEtCrossBaseEquiv`: **the
    30	  componentwise lift** `picEt C ((Over.map σ).obj T) ≃* picEt C_L T`, transporting a
    31	  compatible family of plus classes affine open by affine open along the shuffle.
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtMap_picEtCrossBase` (and `_inv`): **naturality in the test
    33	  object** — the lift commutes with restriction along an arbitrary morphism of `L`-tests
    34	  against its pushforward.  The glued value of `picEtMap` is pinned by the
    35	  `IsPullbackValue` characterization, which the transported family satisfies through the
    36	  `mapAlg`/`appLE` squares of the section-ring shuffle.
    37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtAffineEquiv_picEtCrossBase`: **the affine face** — at an affine
    38	  test `overSpec L A` the lift collapses under the two affine comparisons to the B-2
    39	  shuffle itself, the pushed side being read through the affine matching
    40	  `mapOverSpecIso`.  This is the reduction through which the θ assembly
    41	  (`Picard/Pic0ThetaAssembly.lean`) discharges the `degAt` matching at field points.
    42	
    43	Nothing here unfolds the limit carrier beyond the componentwise interface of
    44	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEt`, and `picEtMap` is consumed only through its
    45	`IsPullbackValue` characterization (the w4/F-3 discipline).  Per the I-0206 elaboration
    46	lesson, every seam-crossing step (the `Γ(T.left, U)` vs
    47	`Γ(((Over.map σ).obj T).left, U)` spellings) is done in term mode with type-ascribed
    48	local instances, never by rewriting.
    49	-/
