    69	/-- The `k`-algebra structure map of a section ring of the pushed-forward `L`-test
    70	`(Over.map σ).obj T` factors through the base extension `k → L`: the `CommRingCat`-level
    71	form of the section-ring tower seam. -/
    72	lemma Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections_map (U : T.left.Opens) :
    73	    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k
    74	        Γ(((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T).left, U))
    75	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)
    76	          ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L Γ(T.left, U)) := by
    77	  have happ : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
    78	        (le_top.trans
    79	          (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).ge)
    80	      = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).appTop :=
    81	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
    82	  have hnat : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).appTop
    83	        ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of L)).hom
    84	      = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L) :=
    85	    Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))
    86	  have h1 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv
    87	        ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).appTop
    88	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L) ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of L)).inv := by
    89	    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← hnat, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    90	      Category.comp_id]
    91	  have hpush : ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T).hom.appLE
    92	        ⊤ U (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top
    93	          ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T).hom).ge)
    94	      = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
    95	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top
    96	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).ge)
    97	        ≫ T.hom.appLE ⊤ U (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge) := by
    98	    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
    99	    exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom rfl ⊤ U _ _
   100	  have hmain : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv
   101	        ≫ ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
   102	            (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top
   103	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).ge)
   104	          ≫ T.hom.appLE ⊤ U (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge))
   105	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)
   106	          ≫ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of L)).inv
   107	            ≫ T.hom.appLE ⊤ U (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge)) := by
   108	    rw [happ, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, h1]
   109	  exact (Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections
   110	      ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) U).trans
   111	    ((congrArg (fun ψ => (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ ψ) hpush).trans
   112	      (hmain.trans
   113	        (congrArg (fun ψ => CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L) ≫ ψ)
   114	          (Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections T U).symm)))

   116	/-- **The section-ring tower seam**: on `Γ(T.left, U)` for an `L`-test object `T`, the
   117	`k`-algebra structure through the pushforward `(Over.map σ).obj T` and the `L`-algebra
   118	structure of `T` itself form a scalar tower. -/
   119	theorem Over.isScalarTower_sections_map (U : T.left.Opens) :
   120	    letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, U) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   121	      ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) U
   122	    IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, U) := by
   123	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, U) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   124	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) U
   125	  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => ?_
   126	  exact congr($(Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections_map k L T U).hom r)

   137	
   138	/-- **The base-field shuffle at a section ring**: for an open `U` of an `L`-test object
   139	`T`, the B-2 shuffle at the test algebra `Γ(T.left, U)`, whose `k`-structure is the
   140	`Over.sectionsAlgebra` of the pushforward `(Over.map σ).obj T` — the componentwise
   141	ingredient of the θ lift. -/
   142	noncomputable def sectionShuffle (U : T.left.Opens) :
   143	    PicEtAff C
   144	        Γ(((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T).left, U)
   145	      ≃* PicEtAff ((baseChange k L).obj C) Γ(T.left, U) :=
   146	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, U) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   147	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) U
   148	  haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, U) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T U
   149	  PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k L C Γ(T.left, U)

   151	/-- The `restrictScalars` reconciliation of the two restriction algebra maps: restriction
   152	of sections of the pushforward is the scalar restriction of restriction of sections. -/
   153	lemma Over.resAlgHom_map_restrictScalars {V W : T.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) :
   154	    letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, V) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   155	      ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) V
   156	    letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, W) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   157	      ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) W
   158	    haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, V) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T V
   159	    haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, W) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T W
   160	    (Over.resAlgHom T h).restrictScalars k
   161	      = Over.resAlgHom
   162	          ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) h := by
   163	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, V) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   164	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) V
   165	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, W) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   166	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) W
   167	  haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, V) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T V
   168	  haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, W) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T W
   169	  exact AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
   170	
   171	/-- **The restriction square of the section-ring shuffle**: shuffling commutes with
   172	restriction of sections along an inclusion of opens (the `mapAlg` bilateral square of
   173	B-2, read at the section rings). -/
   174	theorem mapAlg_sectionShuffle {V W : T.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
   175	    (x : PicEtAff C
   176	      Γ(((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T).left, V)) :
   177	    sectionShuffle k L C T W
   178	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   179	          (Over.resAlgHom
   180	            ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) h) x)
   181	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg ((baseChange k L).obj C) (Over.resAlgHom T h)
   182	          (sectionShuffle k L C T V x) := by
   183	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, V) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   184	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) V
   185	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, W) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   186	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) W
   187	  haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, V) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T V
   188	  haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, W) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T W
   189	  exact Over.resAlgHom_map_restrictScalars k L T h
   190	    ▸ PicEtAff.mapAlg_baseFieldShuffle k L C (Over.resAlgHom T h) x
   191	
   192	/-- The restriction square of the inverse section-ring shuffle. -/
   193	theorem mapAlg_sectionShuffle_symm {V W : T.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
   194	    (y : PicEtAff ((baseChange k L).obj C) Γ(T.left, V)) :
   195	    (sectionShuffle k L C T W).symm
   196	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg ((baseChange k L).obj C) (Over.resAlgHom T h) y)
   197	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   198	          (Over.resAlgHom
   199	            ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) h)
   200	          ((sectionShuffle k L C T V).symm y) := by
   201	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, V) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   202	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) V
   203	  letI : Algebra k Γ(T.left, W) := Over.sectionsAlgebra
   204	    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) W
   205	  haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, V) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T V
   206	  haveI : IsScalarTower k L Γ(T.left, W) := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k L T W
   207	  exact Over.resAlgHom_map_restrictScalars k L T h
   208	    ▸ PicEtAff.mapAlg_baseFieldShuffle_symm k L C (Over.resAlgHom T h) y
   209

   278	    picEt C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T)

   280	  toFun s := ⟨fun U => sectionShuffle k L C T U.1 (s.1 ⟨U.1, U.2⟩), fun U V h => by
   281	    rw [← mapAlg_sectionShuffle k L C T h, s.compat ⟨U.1, U.2⟩ ⟨V.1, V.2⟩ h]⟩
   282	  map_one' := picEt.ext fun U => map_one (sectionShuffle k L C T U.1)

   284	    map_mul (sectionShuffle k L C T U.1) (s.1 ⟨U.1, U.2⟩) (t.1 ⟨U.1, U.2⟩)

   294	/-- **The componentwise lift of the base-field shuffle** (backward direction). -/
   295	noncomputable def picEtCrossBaseInv :
   296	    picEt ((baseChange k L).obj C) T
   297	      →* picEt C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T) where
   298	  toFun t := ⟨fun W => (sectionShuffle k L C T W.1).symm (t.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩),
   299	    fun U V h => by
   300	      rw [← mapAlg_sectionShuffle_symm k L C T h, t.compat ⟨U.1, U.2⟩ ⟨V.1, V.2⟩ h]⟩
   301	  map_one' := picEt.ext fun W => map_one (sectionShuffle k L C T W.1).symm
   302	  map_mul' s t := picEt.ext fun W =>
   303	    map_mul (sectionShuffle k L C T W.1).symm (s.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩) (t.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩)
   304	
   305	/-- The componentwise computation rule of `picEtCrossBaseInv`. -/
   306	@[simp]
   307	lemma picEtCrossBaseInv_val (t : picEt ((baseChange k L).obj C) T)
   308	    (W : ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   309	      (algebraMap k L)))).obj T).left.affineOpens) :
   310	    (picEtCrossBaseInv k L C T t).1 W
   311	      = (sectionShuffle k L C T W.1).symm (t.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩) :=
   312	  rfl

   314	/-- **The componentwise lift of the base-field shuffle is an isomorphism**: the two
   315	directions collapse componentwise by the two-sidedness of the B-2 shuffle. -/
   316	noncomputable def picEtCrossBaseEquiv :
   317	    picEt C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj T)
   318	      ≃* picEt ((baseChange k L).obj C) T where
   319	  toFun := picEtCrossBase k L C T
   320	  invFun := picEtCrossBaseInv k L C T
   321	  left_inv s := picEt.ext fun W =>

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffMap
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The parameterized transport core of the étale plus construction
    10	
    11	The Wave-7 plumbing shared by the curve-direction functoriality (`PicEtAff.curveMap`,
    12	`Picard/PicEtAffCurveMap.lean`) and the base-field shuffle (`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle`,
    13	`Picard/PicEtAffBaseFieldShuffle.lean`): transporting étale-plus Picard classes along a
    14	family of scheme morphisms between the product carriers of two curve bundles — possibly
    15	over *different* base fields — indexed by the literally shared étale covers of the affine
    16	test.
    17	
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily kT D E`: the input datum.  For curve bundles
    19	  `D` over `kD` and `E` over `kE`, a family of scheme morphisms
    20	  `hom B : (D ⊗ overSpec kD B).left ⟶ (E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left`, compatible with the
    21	  second projections (`hom_snd`) and natural against pairs of algebra maps with equal
    22	  underlying functions (`hom_naturality`).  The family is indexed by all test algebras
    23	  `B` carrying algebra structures over `kD`, `kE` and a common overfield `kT` in scalar
    24	  towers `kD → kT → B` and `kE → kT → B`; `kT` mediates between the two base fields
    25	  without relating them (`kT = kD = kE` for the curve-morphism family; `kT = L` for the
    26	  base-field shuffle, where `{kD, kE} = {k, L}`).
    27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom`: the induced transport of relative
    28	  Picard groups, with `relPicHom_mk` and the bilateral naturality square
    29	  `relPicAlgMap_relPicHom` against restriction along same-function algebra-map pairs.
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom`: descent classes map to descent
    31	  classes over the shared cover index, commuting with refinement transport
    32	  (`descentHom_descentMap`).
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom`: the induced homomorphism
    34	  `PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A` of étale-plus groups, with the `mk`-computation rule
    35	  (`picEtAffHom_mk`), naturality of the unit (`picEtAffHom_unit`), the bilateral
    36	  restriction squares (`map_picEtAffHom`, `mapAlg_picEtAffHom`), and the two-sided
    37	  collapse `picEtAffHom_picEtAffHom` (families with pointwise-inverse scheme morphisms
    38	  induce mutually inverse transports — the `≃*` engine of the base-field shuffle).
    39	
    40	Everything is stated through the landed `relPicMk`/`relPic.ind`/`relPicAlgMap` and
    41	`PicEtAff.mk`/`ind`/`mk_eq_mk_iff`/`descentMap` interfaces; nothing unfolds the plus
    42	setoid or the relative Picard quotient beyond them.
    43	-/
    44	
    45	set_option autoImplicit false
    46	
    47	universe u
    48	
    49	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    50	open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme (CechPic)
    51	open scoped TensorProduct
    52	
    53	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    54	
    55	variable {kD kE : Type u} [Field kD] [Field kE]
    56	
    57	/-- A transport family between the relative Picard theories of a curve bundle `D` over
    58	`kD` and a curve bundle `E` over `kE`, on affine tests: for every test algebra `B` in
    59	scalar towers over both base fields through a common overfield `kT`, a scheme morphism
    60	between the product carriers, compatible with the second projections and natural in `B`.
    61	Descending along `Scheme.CechPic.map`, such a family induces a transport
    62	`PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A` of étale-plus Picard groups over the literally shared
    63	étale-cover index (`picEtAffHom`). -/
    64	structure RelPicTransportFamily (kT : Type u) [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
    65	    (D : Over (Spec (.of kD))) (E : Over (Spec (.of kE))) where
    66	  /-- The underlying family of scheme morphisms between the product carriers. -/
    67	  hom : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    68	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B],
    69	    (D ⊗ overSpec kD B).left ⟶ (E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left
    70	  /-- The family commutes with the second projections (both carriers project to the
    71	  shared scheme `Spec B`). -/
    72	  hom_snd : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    73	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B],
    74	    hom B ≫ (snd E (overSpec kE B)).left = (snd D (overSpec kD B)).left
    75	  /-- The family is natural against restriction along any pair of algebra maps over the
    76	  two base fields with equal underlying functions. -/
    77	  hom_naturality : ∀ (B B' : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B]
    78	    [Algebra kT B] [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B]
    79	    [CommRing B'] [Algebra kD B'] [Algebra kE B'] [Algebra kT B']
    80	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B'] [IsScalarTower kE kT B']
    81	    (fD : B →ₐ[kD] B') (fE : B →ₐ[kE] B'), (∀ b, fD b = fE b) →
    82	    hom B' ≫ (E ◁ Over.overSpecMap fE).left
    83	      = (D ◁ Over.overSpecMap fD).left ≫ hom B
    84	
    85	namespace RelPicTransportFamily
    86	
    87	variable {kT : Type u} [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
    88	variable {D : Over (Spec (.of kD))} {E : Over (Spec (.of kE))}
    89	variable (T : RelPicTransportFamily kT D E)
    90	
    91	noncomputable section
    92	
    93	/-! ## The relative Picard transport -/
    94	
    95	section RelPicHom
    96	
    97	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    98	  [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B]
    99	
   100	/-- Pullback of Čech classes along the family sends classes pulled back from the shared
   101	test `Spec B` to classes pulled back from `Spec B`: well-definedness of the transport on
   102	the cosets. -/
   103	lemma picFromBase_le_comap_hom :
   104	    picFromBase E (overSpec kE B)
   105	      ≤ (picFromBase D (overSpec kD B)).comap (CechPic.map (T.hom B)) := by
   106	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
   107	  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
   108	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, T.hom_snd]
   109	  rfl
   110	
   111	/-- The relative Picard transport induced by the family at a test algebra: pull back
   112	Čech classes along `hom B` and descend to the quotients. -/
   113	def relPicHom : relPic E (overSpec kE B) →* relPic D (overSpec kD B) :=
   114	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase E (overSpec kE B)) (picFromBase D (overSpec kD B))
   115	    (CechPic.map (T.hom B)) (T.picFromBase_le_comap_hom B)
   116	
   117	@[simp]
   118	lemma relPicHom_mk (L : (E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left.CechPic) :
   119	    T.relPicHom B (relPicMk E (overSpec kE B) L)
   120	      = relPicMk D (overSpec kD B) (CechPic.map (T.hom B) L) :=
   121	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
   122	
   123	end RelPicHom
   124	
   125	section RelPicSquare
   126	
   127	variable {B B' : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
   128	  [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B]
   129	  [CommRing B'] [Algebra kD B'] [Algebra kE B'] [Algebra kT B']
   130	  [IsScalarTower kD kT B'] [IsScalarTower kE kT B']
   131	
   132	/-- **The bilateral naturality square**: the family transport commutes with restriction
   133	along any pair of algebra maps over the two base fields with equal underlying
   134	functions.  Every compatibility of the plus-level transport reduces to this square. -/
   135	theorem relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (fD : B →ₐ[kD] B') (fE : B →ₐ[kE] B')
   136	    (hf : ∀ b, fD b = fE b) (x : relPic E (overSpec kE B)) :
   137	    relPicAlgMap D fD (T.relPicHom B x) = T.relPicHom B' (relPicAlgMap E fE x) := by
   138	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   139	  | mk L =>
   140	    rw [relPicHom_mk, relPicAlgMap, relPicMap_mk, relPicAlgMap, relPicMap_mk,
   141	      relPicHom_mk]
   142	    refine congrArg (relPicMk D (overSpec kD B')) ?_
   143	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   144	      ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, T.hom_naturality B B' fD fE hf]
   145	
   146	end RelPicSquare
   147	
   148	/-- Families with pointwise-inverse scheme morphisms induce mutually inverse relative
   149	Picard transports: the round trip along `T` then `S` is the identity when
   150	`S.hom B ≫ T.hom B = 𝟙`. -/
   151	theorem relPicHom_relPicHom (S : RelPicTransportFamily kT E D)
   152	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
   153	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B]
   154	    (h : S.hom B ≫ T.hom B = 𝟙 ((E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left))
   155	    (x : relPic E (overSpec kE B)) :
   156	    S.relPicHom B (T.relPicHom B x) = x := by
   157	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   158	  | mk L =>
   159	    rw [relPicHom_mk, relPicHom_mk]
   160	    refine congrArg (relPicMk E (overSpec kE B)) ?_
   161	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, h, Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
   162	    rfl
   163	
   164	/-! ## The descent-class transport -/
   165	
   166	section Descent
   167	
   168	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]
   169	  [IsScalarTower kD kT A] [IsScalarTower kE kT A]
   170	
   171	/-- The descent condition is preserved by the family transport: the two double-cover
   172	pullbacks of the transported class agree, by the bilateral square at the two coprojections
   173	(which are algebra maps over both base fields with the same underlying function). -/
   174	theorem relPicHom_mem_descentClasses {U : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   175	    {x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)} (hx : x ∈ descentClasses E U) :
   176	    T.relPicHom U.Carrier x ∈ descentClasses D U := by
   177	  rw [mem_descentClasses_iff] at hx ⊢
   178	  rw [T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (doubleInl U) (doubleInl U) (fun _ => rfl) x,
   179	    T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (doubleInr U) (doubleInr U) (fun _ => rfl) x, hx]
   180	
   181	/-- The descent-class transport induced by the family, over the literally shared étale
   182	cover index. -/
   183	def descentHom (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
   184	    descentClasses E U →* descentClasses D U :=
   185	  ((T.relPicHom U.Carrier).comp (descentClasses E U).subtype).codRestrict _
   186	    fun x => T.relPicHom_mem_descentClasses x.2
   187	
   188	@[simp]
   189	lemma descentHom_coe (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses E U) :
   190	    (T.descentHom U x : relPic D (overSpec kD U.Carrier))
   191	      = T.relPicHom U.Carrier (x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)) :=
   192	  rfl
   193	
   194	/-- The descent-class transport commutes with refinement transport — what makes the
   195	plus-level transport well defined on `mk`-equal representatives. -/
   196	theorem descentHom_descentMap {U V : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (h : U.Carrier →ₐ[A] V.Carrier)
   197	    (x : descentClasses E U) :
   198	    T.descentHom V (descentMap E h x) = descentMap D h (T.descentHom U x) := by
   199	  ext
   200	  rw [descentHom_coe, descentMap_coe, descentMap_coe, descentHom_coe,
   201	    T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (h.restrictScalars kD) (h.restrictScalars kE)
   202	      (fun _ => rfl)]
   203	
   204	/-! ## The étale-plus transport -/
   205	
   206	variable (A) in
   207	private def mapSig (p : Σ U : Algebra.EtaleCover A, descentClasses E U) :
   208	    Σ U : Algebra.EtaleCover A, descentClasses D U :=
   209	  ⟨p.1, T.descentHom p.1 p.2⟩
   210	
   211	/- Stated with the sigma pairs destructured, so that no goal mentions a sigma-literal
   212	projection. -/
   213	private lemma mapSig_rel {U V : Algebra.EtaleCover A} {x : descentClasses E U}
   214	    {y : descentClasses E V} (F : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (f : U.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
   215	    (g : V.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) (hfg : descentMap E f x = descentMap E g y) :
   216	    descentMap D f (T.descentHom U x) = descentMap D g (T.descentHom V y) := by
   217	  rw [← T.descentHom_descentMap f x, ← T.descentHom_descentMap g y, hfg]
   218	
   219	private lemma mapSig_compat {p q : Σ U : Algebra.EtaleCover A, descentClasses E U}
   220	    (h : p ≈ q) : T.mapSig A p ≈ T.mapSig A q := by
   221	  obtain ⟨F, f, g, hfg⟩ := h
   222	  exact ⟨F, f, g, T.mapSig_rel F f g hfg⟩
   223	
   224	variable (A) in
   225	private def mapFun : PicEtAff E A → PicEtAff D A :=
   226	  Quotient.map (T.mapSig A) fun _ _ h => T.mapSig_compat h
   227	
   228	private lemma mapFun_mk (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses E U) :
   229	    T.mapFun A (PicEtAff.mk E U x) = PicEtAff.mk D U (T.descentHom U x) :=
   230	  rfl
   231	
   232	private lemma mapFun_mul (a b : PicEtAff E A) :
   233	    T.mapFun A (a * b) = T.mapFun A a * T.mapFun A b := by
   234	  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with | _ U x =>
   235	  induction b using PicEtAff.ind with | _ V y =>
   236	  rw [PicEtAff.mk_mul_mk, mapFun_mk, mapFun_mk, mapFun_mk, PicEtAff.mk_mul_mk, map_mul,
   237	    T.descentHom_descentMap, T.descentHom_descentMap]
   238	
   239	variable (A) in
   240	/-- The étale-plus transport induced by the family: a homomorphism of étale-plus Picard
   241	groups over the literally shared cover index, transporting each descent-class
   242	representative by `descentHom`. -/
   243	def picEtAffHom : PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A :=
   244	  MonoidHom.mk' (T.mapFun A) fun a b => T.mapFun_mul a b
   245	
   246	@[simp]
   247	lemma picEtAffHom_mk (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses E U) :
   248	    T.picEtAffHom A (PicEtAff.mk E U x) = PicEtAff.mk D U (T.descentHom U x) :=
   249	  rfl
   250	
   251	/-- The étale-plus transport is compatible with the unit of the plus construction: on
   252	classes pulled back to the trivial cover, it is the relative Picard transport. -/
   253	theorem picEtAffHom_unit (x : relPic E (overSpec kE A)) :
   254	    T.picEtAffHom A (PicEtAff.unit E A x) = PicEtAff.unit D A (T.relPicHom A x) := by
   255	  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk D (Algebra.EtaleCover.self A)) (Subtype.ext ?_)
   256	  rw [descentHom_coe]
   257	  exact (T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom
   258	    ((Algebra.ofId A (Algebra.EtaleCover.self A).Carrier).restrictScalars kD)
   259	    ((Algebra.ofId A (Algebra.EtaleCover.self A).Carrier).restrictScalars kE)
   260	    (fun _ => rfl) x).symm
   261	
   262	/-- Families with pointwise-inverse scheme morphisms induce mutually inverse étale-plus
   263	transports: the round trip along `T` then `S` is the identity when
   264	`S.hom B ≫ T.hom B = 𝟙` for every test algebra.  Two-sided instantiation upgrades the
   265	transport to a `MulEquiv` — the engine of the base-field shuffle. -/
   266	theorem picEtAffHom_picEtAffHom (S : RelPicTransportFamily kT E D)
   267	    (h : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
   268	      [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B],
   269	      S.hom B ≫ T.hom B = 𝟙 ((E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left))
   270	    (a : PicEtAff E A) :
   271	    S.picEtAffHom A (T.picEtAffHom A a) = a := by
   272	  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with | _ U x =>
   273	  rw [picEtAffHom_mk, picEtAffHom_mk]
   274	  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk E U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
   275	  rw [descentHom_coe, descentHom_coe, T.relPicHom_relPicHom S U.Carrier (h U.Carrier)]
   276	
   277	end Descent

   279	/-! ## The bilateral restriction squares -/
   280	
   281	section Bilateral
   282	
   283	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]
   284	  [IsScalarTower kD kT A] [IsScalarTower kE kT A]
   285	  {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] [Algebra kD A'] [Algebra kE A'] [Algebra kT A']
   286	  [IsScalarTower kD kT A'] [IsScalarTower kE kT A']
   287	
   288	/-- The étale-plus transport commutes with restriction along a base extension of affine
   289	tests (instance form): the two transports of a representative land on the literally same
   290	base-changed cover, where they agree by the bilateral square at the canonical
   291	inclusion. -/
   292	theorem map_picEtAffHom [Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower kD A A'] [IsScalarTower kE A A']
   293	    (a : PicEtAff E A) :
   294	    T.picEtAffHom A' (PicEtAff.map E A' a) = PicEtAff.map D A' (T.picEtAffHom A a) := by
   295	  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with | _ U x =>
   296	  rw [PicEtAff.map_mk, picEtAffHom_mk, picEtAffHom_mk, PicEtAff.map_mk]
   297	  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk D (U.baseChange A')) (Subtype.ext ?_)
   298	  rw [descentHom_coe, descentBaseChange_coe, descentBaseChange_coe, descentHom_coe,
   299	    T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom ((U.baseChangeInclude A').restrictScalars kD)
   300	      ((U.baseChangeInclude A').restrictScalars kE) (fun _ => rfl)]
   301	
   302	/-- The étale-plus transport commutes with restriction along an explicit algebra map of
   303	affine tests, stated for a `kT`-algebra map restricted to the two base fields — the
   304	`mapAlg` bilateral square. -/
   305	theorem mapAlg_picEtAffHom (φ : A →ₐ[kT] A') (a : PicEtAff E A) :
   306	    T.picEtAffHom A' (PicEtAff.mapAlg E (φ.restrictScalars kE) a)
   307	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg D (φ.restrictScalars kD) (T.picEtAffHom A a) := by
   308	  letI : Algebra A A' := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   309	  haveI : IsScalarTower kD A A' :=
   310	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun r => ((φ.restrictScalars kD).commutes r).symm
   311	  haveI : IsScalarTower kE A A' :=
   312	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun r => ((φ.restrictScalars kE).commutes r).symm
   313	  change T.picEtAffHom A' (PicEtAff.map E A' a) = PicEtAff.map D A' (T.picEtAffHom A a)
   314	  exact T.map_picEtAffHom a
   315	
   316	end Bilateral
   317	
   318	end
   319

     9	/-!
    10	# The base-field shuffle of the étale plus construction (Wave 7, W7-B2)
    11	
    12	For a field embedding `k → L` and a curve bundle `C` over `k`, étale-plus Picard classes
    13	of `C` at an affine test `Spec A` in a scalar tower `k → L → A` shuffle to étale-plus
    14	Picard classes of the base-changed curve `C_L = (baseChange k L).obj C` at the *same*
    15	test — over the literally shared étale-cover index (`Algebra.EtaleCover A` never mentions
    16	the base field).  This file instantiates the parameterized transport core
    17	(`Picard/PicEtAffTransport.lean`, the F-2/B-2 shared D2-ii skeleton) at B-4a's
    18	same-carrier comparison family `crossBaseAffineIso` (`Picard/Pic0Theta.lean`), in both
    19	directions, and packages the two-sided collapse as a `MulEquiv`.
    20	
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.crossBaseAffineIso_inv_naturality`: the inverse-side naturality of
    22	  the same-carrier comparison in the test algebra (the `inv` face of B-4a's
    23	  `crossBaseAffineIso_naturality`).
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.crossBaseTransportFamily` / `crossBaseTransportFamilyInv`: the two
    25	  transport families, with `hom := (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).hom` (resp. `.inv`); the
    26	  core's two-sided instance index collapses at the tower diagonal `kT = L` by
    27	  `Algebra.algebra_ext`, so at a shared instance pack the families are definitionally
    28	  the comparison itself (`crossBaseTransportFamily_hom`, `crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom`)
    29	  and the induced relative Picard transports are definitionally B-4a's
    30	  `relPicCrossBase`/`relPicCrossBaseInv` (`crossBaseTransportFamily_relPicHom`,
    31	  `crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_relPicHom`) — the mk-level reconciliation through which
    32	  the landed degree seam `relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase` transfers to the plus level.
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k L C A :
    34	  PicEtAff C A ≃* PicEtAff ((baseChange k L).obj C) A`: the base-field shuffle, with the
    35	  computation rules `baseFieldShuffle_mk`/`baseFieldShuffle_symm_mk` (descent-class
    36	  representatives transport by `relPicCrossBase`/`relPicCrossBaseInv` on the same cover:
    37	  `crossBaseTransportFamily_descentHom_coe`, `crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_descentHom_coe`),
    38	  the `mk`-equality transport `baseFieldShuffle_mk_eq_mk`, naturality of the unit
    39	  (`baseFieldShuffle_unit`, `baseFieldShuffle_symm_unit`), and the bilateral restriction
    40	  squares `map_baseFieldShuffle`/`mapAlg_baseFieldShuffle` (and their `symm` faces).
    41	
    42	B-4b (`θ`) consumes this interface componentwise over affine opens through
    43	`picEtAffineEquiv`; nothing here unfolds the plus setoid beyond the landed
    44	`mk`/`ind`/`mk_eq_mk_iff` API, and all cross-presentation degree facts route through
    45	B-4a's `relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase` via the `descentHom` reconciliation.
    46	-/
    47	
    48	set_option autoImplicit false
    49	
    50	universe u
    51	
    52	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    53	open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme (CechPic)
    54	
    55	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    56	
    57	variable (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    58	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    59	
    60	/-- Two `F`-algebra structures on the same ring sitting in a scalar tower over the
    61	identity algebra `Algebra.id F` are equal — the seam that collapses the transport core's
    62	two-sided instance index at the tower diagonal `kT = L` (the base-field-shuffle sibling
    63	of the F-2 collapse at `kD = kE = kT = k`). -/
    64	private lemma algebra_eq_of_tower {F B : Type u} [Field F] [CommRing B]
    65	    (iT iD : Algebra F B)
    66	    (tw : @IsScalarTower F F B (Algebra.id F).toSMul iT.toSMul iD.toSMul) :
    67	    iD = iT := by
    68	  refine Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => ?_
    69	  rw [@IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq F F B _ _ _ (Algebra.id F) iT iD tw]
    70	  rfl
    71	
    72	/-- **Inverse-side naturality of the same-carrier comparison in the test algebra**: for
    73	an `L`-algebra map `f : A →ₐ[L] B` in towers over `k`, the inverse comparisons intertwine
    74	`Spec f` whiskered on the two sides — the `inv` face of B-4a's
    75	`crossBaseAffineIso_naturality`. -/
    76	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_naturality (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    77	    [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower k L A] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    78	    [Algebra L B] [IsScalarTower k L B] (f : A →ₐ[L] B) :
    79	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).inv
    80	        ≫ (((baseChange k L).obj C) ◁ Over.overSpecMap f).left
    81	      = (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (f.restrictScalars k)).left
    82	          ≫ (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv := by
    83	  rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, crossBaseAffineIso_naturality k L C A B f,
    84	    Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    85	
    86	/-- **The forward base-field transport family** (the D2-ii core instantiated at B-1/B-4a):
    87	at every test algebra `B` in a scalar tower `k → L → B`, the same-carrier comparison
    88	`(crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).hom`.  The `hom` field is stated across the two `L`-instance
    89	slots of the transport core's index (`kD = kT = L`); the scalar tower collapses them
    90	(`algebra_eq_of_tower`), and at a shared instance pack the field is definitionally the
    91	comparison itself (`crossBaseTransportFamily_hom`). -/
    92	noncomputable def crossBaseTransportFamily :
    93	    RelPicTransportFamily L ((baseChange k L).obj C) C where
    94	  hom B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
    95	    obtain rfl : iD = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iD twD
    96	    exact (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).hom
    97	  hom_snd B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
    98	    obtain rfl : iD = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iD twD
    99	    exact crossBaseAffineIso_hom_snd k L C B
   100	  hom_naturality B B' _ iDB iEB iTB twDB twEB _ iDB' iEB' iTB' twDB' twEB' fD fE hf := by
   101	    obtain rfl : iDB = iTB := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iDB twDB
   102	    obtain rfl : iDB' = iTB' := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iDB' twDB'
   103	    obtain rfl : fE = fD.restrictScalars k := AlgHom.ext fun b => (hf b).symm
   104	    exact crossBaseAffineIso_naturality k L C B B' fD
   105	
   106	/-- **The backward base-field transport family**: the inverse comparisons
   107	`(crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).inv`, collapsing the core's index at `kE = kT = L`.  At a
   108	shared instance pack the field is definitionally the inverse comparison
   109	(`crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom`). -/
   110	noncomputable def crossBaseTransportFamilyInv :
   111	    RelPicTransportFamily L C ((baseChange k L).obj C) where
   112	  hom B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
   113	    obtain rfl : iE = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE
   114	    exact (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).inv
   115	  hom_snd B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
   116	    obtain rfl : iE = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE
   117	    exact crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k L C B
   118	  hom_naturality B B' _ iDB iEB iTB twDB twEB _ iDB' iEB' iTB' twDB' twEB' fD fE hf := by
   119	    obtain rfl : iEB = iTB := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iEB twEB
   120	    obtain rfl : iEB' = iTB' := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iEB' twEB'
   121	    obtain rfl : fD = fE.restrictScalars k := AlgHom.ext hf
   122	    exact crossBaseAffineIso_inv_naturality k L C B B' fE
   123	
   124	section Anchors
   125	
   126	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra L B] [IsScalarTower k L B]
   127	
   128	/-- At a shared instance pack, the forward family is the same-carrier comparison. -/
   129	lemma crossBaseTransportFamily_hom :
   130	    (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).hom B = (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).hom :=
   131	  rfl
   132	
   133	/-- At a shared instance pack, the backward family is the inverse comparison. -/
   134	lemma crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom :
   135	    (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).hom B = (crossBaseAffineIso k L C B).inv :=
   136	  rfl
   137	
   138	/-- **The mk-level reconciliation with B-4a** (forward): at a shared instance pack, the
   139	relative Picard transport induced by the forward family is B-4a's relPic-level shuffle
   140	`relPicCrossBase` — the identification through which the landed degree seam
   141	`relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase` transfers to the plus level. -/
   142	lemma crossBaseTransportFamily_relPicHom :
   143	    (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).relPicHom B = relPicCrossBase k L C B :=
   144	  rfl
   145	
   146	/-- The mk-level reconciliation with B-4a (backward): the relative Picard transport
   147	induced by the backward family is `relPicCrossBaseInv`. -/
   148	lemma crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_relPicHom :
   149	    (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).relPicHom B = relPicCrossBaseInv k L C B :=
   150	  rfl
   151	
   152	end Anchors

   154	namespace PicEtAff
   155	
   156	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower k L A]
   157	
   158	noncomputable section
   159	
   160	/-- **The base-field shuffle of the étale plus construction** (Wave-7 brick B-2): for a
   161	test algebra `A` in a scalar tower `k → L → A`, étale-plus Picard classes of the `k`-curve
   162	`C` and of the base-changed curve `C_L = (baseChange k L).obj C` at the test `A`
   163	correspond, over the literally shared étale-cover index — descent-class representatives
   164	transport by B-4a's `relPicCrossBase` on the same cover.  The two directions are the
   165	transport core's `picEtAffHom` at the forward and backward comparison families; the round
   166	trips collapse by `picEtAffHom_picEtAffHom` since the underlying scheme morphisms are
   167	pointwise inverse. -/
   168	def baseFieldShuffle : PicEtAff C A ≃* PicEtAff ((baseChange k L).obj C) A where
   169	  toFun := (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).picEtAffHom A
   170	  invFun := (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).picEtAffHom A
   171	  left_inv a :=
   172	    (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).picEtAffHom_picEtAffHom
   173	      (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C)
   174	      (fun B _ iD iE iT twD twE => by
   175	        obtain rfl : iD = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iD twD
   176	        exact Iso.inv_hom_id _) a
   177	  right_inv a :=
   178	    (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).picEtAffHom_picEtAffHom
   179	      (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C)
   180	      (fun B _ iD iE iT twD twE => by
   181	        obtain rfl : iE = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE
   182	        exact Iso.hom_inv_id _) a
   183	  map_mul' := map_mul ((crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).picEtAffHom A)
   184	
   185	variable {A}
   186	
   187	@[simp]
   188	lemma baseFieldShuffle_apply (a : PicEtAff C A) :
   189	    baseFieldShuffle k L C A a = (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).picEtAffHom A a :=
   190	  rfl
   191	
   192	@[simp]
   193	lemma baseFieldShuffle_symm_apply (b : PicEtAff ((baseChange k L).obj C) A) :
   194	    (baseFieldShuffle k L C A).symm b
   195	      = (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).picEtAffHom A b :=
   196	  rfl
   197	
   198	/-- The computation rule of the shuffle: representatives transport cover-by-cover, on the
   199	literally shared cover. -/
   200	@[simp]
   201	theorem baseFieldShuffle_mk (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C U) :
   202	    baseFieldShuffle k L C A (mk C U x)
   203	      = mk ((baseChange k L).obj C) U
   204	          ((crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).descentHom U x) :=
   205	  rfl
   206	
   207	/-- The computation rule of the inverse shuffle. -/
   208	@[simp]
   209	theorem baseFieldShuffle_symm_mk (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   210	    (x : descentClasses ((baseChange k L).obj C) U) :
   211	    (baseFieldShuffle k L C A).symm (mk ((baseChange k L).obj C) U x)
   212	      = mk C U ((crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).descentHom U x) :=
   213	  rfl
   214	
   215	/-- The descent-class transport of the forward family is B-4a's `relPicCrossBase` on the
   216	underlying relative Picard classes — the mk-level identification consumed by B-4b's
   217	degree matching (route through `relPicDeg_relPicCrossBase`). -/
   218	@[simp]
   219	theorem crossBaseTransportFamily_descentHom_coe (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   220	    (x : descentClasses C U) :
   221	    (((crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).descentHom U x)
   222	        : relPic ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L U.Carrier))
   223	      = relPicCrossBase k L C U.Carrier (x : relPic C (overSpec k U.Carrier)) :=
   224	  rfl
   225	
   226	/-- The descent-class transport of the backward family is `relPicCrossBaseInv` on the
   227	underlying relative Picard classes. -/
   228	@[simp]
   229	theorem crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_descentHom_coe (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   230	    (x : descentClasses ((baseChange k L).obj C) U) :
   231	    (((crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).descentHom U x)
   232	        : relPic C (overSpec k U.Carrier))
   233	      = relPicCrossBaseInv k L C U.Carrier
   234	          (x : relPic ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L U.Carrier)) :=
   235	  rfl
   236	
   237	/-- The shuffle transports `mk`-equalities: representatives identified in the plus of `C`
   238	stay identified after the base-field shuffle — the plus-level face of the core's
   239	`descentHom_descentMap`. -/
   240	theorem baseFieldShuffle_mk_eq_mk {U V : Algebra.EtaleCover A} {x : descentClasses C U}
   241	    {y : descentClasses C V} (h : mk C U x = mk C V y) :
   242	    mk ((baseChange k L).obj C) U ((crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).descentHom U x)
   243	      = mk ((baseChange k L).obj C) V
   244	          ((crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).descentHom V y) := by
   245	  rw [← baseFieldShuffle_mk, ← baseFieldShuffle_mk, h]
   246	
   247	/-- The inverse shuffle transports `mk`-equalities. -/
   248	theorem baseFieldShuffle_symm_mk_eq_mk {U V : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   249	    {x : descentClasses ((baseChange k L).obj C) U}
   250	    {y : descentClasses ((baseChange k L).obj C) V}
   251	    (h : mk ((baseChange k L).obj C) U x = mk ((baseChange k L).obj C) V y) :
   252	    mk C U ((crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).descentHom U x)
   253	      = mk C V ((crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).descentHom V y) := by
   254	  rw [← baseFieldShuffle_symm_mk, ← baseFieldShuffle_symm_mk, h]
   255	
   256	/-- The base-field shuffle is compatible with the unit of the plus construction: on
   257	classes pulled back to the trivial cover it is B-4a's relPic-level shuffle. -/
   258	theorem baseFieldShuffle_unit (x : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
   259	    baseFieldShuffle k L C A (unit C A x)
   260	      = unit ((baseChange k L).obj C) A (relPicCrossBase k L C A x) :=
   261	  (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).picEtAffHom_unit x
   262	
   263	/-- The inverse shuffle is compatible with the unit of the plus construction. -/
   264	theorem baseFieldShuffle_symm_unit (y : relPic ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)) :
   265	    (baseFieldShuffle k L C A).symm (unit ((baseChange k L).obj C) A y)
   266	      = unit C A (relPicCrossBaseInv k L C A y) :=
   267	  (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).picEtAffHom_unit y
   268	
   269	section Bilateral
   270	
   271	variable (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A'] [Algebra L A']
   272	  [IsScalarTower k L A']
   273	
   274	/-- The base-field shuffle commutes with restriction along a base extension of affine
   275	tests (instance form). -/
   276	theorem map_baseFieldShuffle [Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower k A A']
   277	    [IsScalarTower L A A'] (a : PicEtAff C A) :
   278	    baseFieldShuffle k L C A' (map C A' a)
   279	      = map ((baseChange k L).obj C) A' (baseFieldShuffle k L C A a) :=
   280	  (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).map_picEtAffHom a
   281	
   282	/-- The inverse shuffle commutes with restriction along a base extension of affine tests
   283	(instance form). -/
   284	theorem map_baseFieldShuffle_symm [Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower k A A']
   285	    [IsScalarTower L A A'] (b : PicEtAff ((baseChange k L).obj C) A) :
   286	    (baseFieldShuffle k L C A').symm (map ((baseChange k L).obj C) A' b)
   287	      = map C A' ((baseFieldShuffle k L C A).symm b) :=
   288	  (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).map_picEtAffHom b
   289	
   290	variable {A'}
   291	
   292	/-- **The `mapAlg` bilateral square**: the base-field shuffle commutes with restriction
   293	along an explicit `L`-algebra map of affine tests (restricted to `k` on the `k`-curve
   294	side). -/
   295	theorem mapAlg_baseFieldShuffle (φ : A →ₐ[L] A') (a : PicEtAff C A) :
   296	    baseFieldShuffle k L C A' (mapAlg C (φ.restrictScalars k) a)
   297	      = mapAlg ((baseChange k L).obj C) φ (baseFieldShuffle k L C A a) :=
   298	  (crossBaseTransportFamily k L C).mapAlg_picEtAffHom φ a
   299	
   300	/-- The `mapAlg` bilateral square for the inverse shuffle. -/
   301	theorem mapAlg_baseFieldShuffle_symm (φ : A →ₐ[L] A')
   302	    (b : PicEtAff ((baseChange k L).obj C) A) :
   303	    (baseFieldShuffle k L C A').symm (mapAlg ((baseChange k L).obj C) φ b)
   304	      = mapAlg C (φ.restrictScalars k) ((baseFieldShuffle k L C A).symm b) :=
   305	  (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).mapAlg_picEtAffHom φ b
   306	
   307	end Bilateral
   308	
   309	end
   310

     9	/-!
    10	# Functoriality of the étale plus construction in the curve
    11	
    12	For a morphism of curve bundles `g : D ⟶ E` over `Spec k`, transport of relative Picard
    13	classes along `g ▷ T` (the landed `relPicMapCurveApp`) descends through the étale plus
    14	construction over the literally shared cover index: this file instantiates the
    15	parameterized transport core (`Picard/PicEtAffTransport.lean`) at the whisker family
    16	`fun B => (g ▷ overSpec k B).left` and packages the result as the curve-direction
    17	functoriality of `PicEtAff`.
    18	
    19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.curveTransportFamily g`: the whisker transport family.  Its `hom`
    20	  field is stated for two a priori unrelated `k`-algebra structures on the test algebra
    21	  (the scalar towers of the core's index force them to agree), so it is spelled as the
    22	  underlying `pullback.map` of the whisker; at a shared instance it is definitionally
    23	  `(g ▷ overSpec k B).left` (`curveTransportFamily_hom`), and the induced relative
    24	  Picard transport is definitionally `relPicMapCurveApp`
    25	  (`curveTransportFamily_relPicHom`).
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.curveMap g A : PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A`: the induced
    27	  homomorphism of étale-plus Picard groups, with the computation rule `curveMap_mk`
    28	  (descent-class representatives transport by `relPicMapCurveApp` on the same cover),
    29	  the `mk`-equality transport `curveMap_mk_eq_mk`, the functor laws
    30	  `curveMap_id`/`curveMap_comp`, naturality of the unit (`curveMap_unit`), and the
    31	  bilateral restriction squares `map_curveMap`/`mapAlg_curveMap`.
    32	
    33	The étale-limit layer (`picEt`) consumes this interface through `curveMap_mk`,
    34	`curveMap_unit` and the `mapAlg` square; nothing here unfolds the plus setoid beyond the
    35	landed `mk`/`ind`/`mk_eq_mk_iff` API.

    49	/-- Two `k`-algebra structures on the same ring sitting in a scalar tower over the
    50	identity algebra `Algebra.id k` are equal — the seam that collapses the transport core's
    51	two-sided instance index at the diagonal `kD = kE = kT = k`. -/
    52	private lemma algebra_eq_of_tower {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (iT iD : Algebra k B)
    53	    (tw : @IsScalarTower k k B (Algebra.id k).toSMul iT.toSMul iD.toSMul) :
    54	    iD = iT := by
    55	  refine Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => ?_
    56	  rw [@IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k B _ _ _ (Algebra.id k) iT iD tw]
    57	  rfl
    58	
    59	/-- The whisker transport family of a curve morphism `g : D ⟶ E`: at every test algebra
    60	`B`, pullback of Čech classes along `(g ▷ overSpec k B).left`.  The `hom` field is
    61	stated across the two instance slots of the transport core's index; the scalar towers
    62	collapse them (`algebra_eq_of_tower`), and at a shared instance the field is
    63	definitionally the whisker itself (`curveTransportFamily_hom`). -/
    64	noncomputable def curveTransportFamily (g : D ⟶ E) : RelPicTransportFamily k D E where
    65	  hom B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
    66	    obtain rfl : iE = iD :=
    67	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE).trans (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iD twD).symm
    68	    obtain rfl : iE = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE
    69	    exact (g ▷ overSpec k B).left
    70	  hom_snd B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
    71	    obtain rfl : iE = iD :=
    72	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE).trans (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iD twD).symm
    73	    obtain rfl : iE = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE
    74	    change (g ▷ overSpec k B).left ≫ (snd E (overSpec k B)).left
    75	      = (snd D (overSpec k B)).left
    76	    rw [← Over.comp_left, whiskerRight_snd]
    77	  hom_naturality B B' _ iDB iEB iTB twDB twEB _ iDB' iEB' iTB' twDB' twEB' fD fE hf := by
    78	    obtain rfl : iEB = iDB :=
    79	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iEB twEB).trans (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iDB twDB).symm
    80	    obtain rfl : iEB = iTB := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iEB twEB
    81	    obtain rfl : iEB' = iDB' :=
    82	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iEB' twEB').trans
    83	        (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iDB' twDB').symm
    84	    obtain rfl : iEB' = iTB' := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iEB' twEB'
    85	    obtain rfl : fD = fE := AlgHom.ext hf
    86	    change (g ▷ overSpec k B').left ≫ (E ◁ Over.overSpecMap fD).left
    87	      = (D ◁ Over.overSpecMap fD).left ≫ (g ▷ overSpec k B).left
    88	    rw [← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whisker_exchange]

    91	lemma curveTransportFamily_hom (g : D ⟶ E) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :

    97	lemma curveTransportFamily_relPicHom (g : D ⟶ E) (B : Type u) [CommRing B]

   104	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

   106	noncomputable section
   107	
   108	/-- **Functoriality of the étale plus construction in the curve**: a morphism of curve
   109	bundles `g : D ⟶ E` over `Spec k` induces a homomorphism of étale-plus Picard groups
   110	`PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A` at every affine test, over the literally shared étale
   111	cover index — descent-class representatives transport by `relPicMapCurveApp` on the same
   112	cover. -/
   113	def curveMap (g : D ⟶ E) : PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A :=
   114	  (curveTransportFamily g).picEtAffHom A
   115	
   116	variable {A}
   117	
   118	/-- The computation rule of `curveMap`: representatives transport cover-by-cover. -/
   119	@[simp]
   120	theorem curveMap_mk (g : D ⟶ E) (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses E U) :
   121	    curveMap A g (mk E U x) = mk D U ((curveTransportFamily g).descentHom U x) :=
   122	  rfl
   123	
   124	/-- The descent-class transport of the whisker family is `relPicMapCurveApp` on the
   125	underlying relative Picard classes. -/
   126	@[simp]
   127	theorem curveTransportFamily_descentHom_coe (g : D ⟶ E) (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   128	    (x : descentClasses E U) :
   129	    (((curveTransportFamily g).descentHom U x) : relPic D (overSpec k U.Carrier))
   130	      = relPicMapCurveApp g (overSpec k U.Carrier)
   131	          (x : relPic E (overSpec k U.Carrier)) :=
   132	  rfl
   133	
   134	/-- `curveMap` transports `mk`-equalities: representatives identified in the plus of `E`
   135	stay identified after curve transport — the plus-level face of `descentHom_descentMap`. -/
   136	theorem curveMap_mk_eq_mk (g : D ⟶ E) {U V : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   137	    {x : descentClasses E U} {y : descentClasses E V} (h : mk E U x = mk E V y) :
   138	    mk D U ((curveTransportFamily g).descentHom U x)
   139	      = mk D V ((curveTransportFamily g).descentHom V y) := by
   140	  rw [← curveMap_mk, ← curveMap_mk, h]
   141	
   142	/-- The identity curve morphism induces the identity transport. -/
   143	theorem curveMap_id (a : PicEtAff E A) : curveMap A (𝟙 E) a = a := by
   144	  induction a using ind with | _ U x =>
   145	  rw [curveMap_mk]
   146	  refine congrArg (mk E U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
   147	  rw [curveTransportFamily_descentHom_coe]
   148	  exact relPicMapCurveApp_id _ _
   149	
   150	/-- A composite of curve morphisms induces the composite transport, contravariantly. -/
   151	theorem curveMap_comp (g : D ⟶ E) (g' : E ⟶ F) (a : PicEtAff F A) :
   152	    curveMap A (g ≫ g') a = curveMap A g (curveMap A g' a) := by
   153	  induction a using ind with | _ U x =>
   154	  rw [curveMap_mk, curveMap_mk, curveMap_mk]
   155	  refine congrArg (mk D U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
   156	  rw [curveTransportFamily_descentHom_coe, curveTransportFamily_descentHom_coe,
   157	    curveTransportFamily_descentHom_coe]
   158	  exact relPicMapCurveApp_comp g g' _ _
   159	
   160	/-- Curve transport is compatible with the unit of the plus construction: on classes
   161	pulled back to the trivial cover it is the relative Picard curve transport. -/
   162	theorem curveMap_unit (g : D ⟶ E) (x : relPic E (overSpec k A)) :
   163	    curveMap A g (unit E A x) = unit D A (relPicMapCurveApp g (overSpec k A) x) :=
   164	  (curveTransportFamily g).picEtAffHom_unit x
   165	
   166	/-- Curve transport commutes with restriction along a base extension of affine tests
   167	(instance form). -/
   168	theorem map_curveMap (g : D ⟶ E) (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A']
   169	    [Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower k A A'] (a : PicEtAff E A) :
   170	    curveMap A' g (map E A' a) = map D A' (curveMap A g a) :=
   171	  (curveTransportFamily g).map_picEtAffHom a
   172	
   173	/-- **The `mapAlg` bilateral square**: curve transport commutes with restriction along an
   174	explicit `k`-algebra map of affine tests. -/
   175	theorem mapAlg_curveMap (g : D ⟶ E) {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A']
   176	    (φ : A →ₐ[k] A') (a : PicEtAff E A) :
   177	    curveMap A' g (mapAlg E φ a) = mapAlg D φ (curveMap A g a) :=
   178	  (curveTransportFamily g).mapAlg_picEtAffHom φ a
   179	
   180	end

events.text: The timeout report confirms the issue is proof-term size, not missing mathematics. I’m decomposing the affine shuffle theorem at the two quotient boundaries: first a relative-Picard tower lemma, then a single representative lemma, leaving the public theorem as a thin induction. This makes each kernel check opaque at a useful boundary.

data.content:
· exact hprojC
    · exact hprojM
  apply (Over.isPullback_left CM (overSpec M B)).hom_ext
  · exact hfst
  · exact hsnd

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- The inverse affine base-field shuffle over a scalar tower is the composite of the two
successive inverse shuffles and transport along the frozen curve comparison. -/
theorem PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle_symm_tower
    (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k B] [Algebra L B] [Algebra M B]
    [IsScalarTower k L B] [IsScalarTower L M B] [IsScalarTower k M B]
    (a : PicEtAff ((baseChange k M).obj C) B) :
    (PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k M C B).symm a =
      (PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle k L C B).symm
        ((PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle L M ((baseChange k L).obj C) B).symm
          (PicEtAff.curveMap B ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv a)) := by
  let g : (baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C) ⟶ (baseChange k M).obj C :=
    ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C).inv
  change (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k M C).picEtAffHom B a =
    (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k L C).picEtAffHom B
      ((crossBaseTransportFamilyInv L M ((baseChange k L).obj C)).picEtAffHom B
        ((curveTransportFamily g).picEtAffHom B a))
  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
  | mk U x =>
    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk,

    generalize (x : relPic ((baseChange k M).obj C) (overSpec M U.Carrier)) = y

      refine congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k U.Carrier)) ?_
      rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply,
        ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
        crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom, crossBaseTransportFamilyInv_hom,

        crossBaseAffineIso_inv_tower k L M C U.Carrier]
      dsimp [g]
